original: athavā niratiśayāyāḥ prīteḥ svargaśabdavācyāyāḥ karmahetutvāt karmabhya eva mokṣa iti cet / na / karmānekatvāt / anekāni hy ārabdhaphalāny anārabdhaphalāni cānekajanmāntarakṛtāni viruddhaphalāni karmāṇi sambhavanti /

original: atas teṣv anārabdhaphalānām ekasmiñ janmany upabhogena kṣayāsambhavāt śeṣakarmanimittaśarīrārambhopapattiḥ, karmaśeṣasadbhāvasiddhiś ca / tad ya iha ramaṇīyacaraṇāḥ (ChU 5,10.7) tataḥ śeṣeṇa ity ādiśrutismṛtiśatebhyaḥ / iṣṭāniṣṭaphalānām anārabdhānāṃ kṣayārthāni nityānīti cen na / akaraṇe pratyavāyaśravaṇāt /
analyzed: atas teṣu anārabdha phalānām ekasmin janmani upabhogena kṣaya asambhavāt śeṣa karma nimitta śarīra ārambha upapattiḥ karma śeṣa sadbhāva siddhiḥ ca tad SANe ye iha ramaṇīya caraṇa PNM tatas śeṣeṇa iti ādi śruti smṛti śatebhyaḥ iṣṭa aniṣṭa phalānām anārabdhānām kṣaya arthāni nityāni iti ced na akaraṇe pratyavāya śravaṇāt

original: pratyavāyaśabdo hy aniṣṭaviṣayaḥ nityākaraṇanimittasya pratyavāyasya duḥkharūpasyāgāminaḥ parihārārthāni nityānītyabhyupagamān nānārabdhaphalakarmakṣayārthāni / yadi nāmānārabdhaphalakarmakṣayārthani nityāni karmāṇi, tathāpy aśuddham eva kṣapayeyur na śuddha virodhābhāvāt / na hīṣṭaphalasya karmaṇaḥ śuddharūpatvān nityair virodha upapadyate /
analyzed: pratyavāya śabdaḥ hi aniṣṭa viṣayaḥ nitya akaraṇa nimittasya pratyavāyasya duḥkha rūpasya āgāminaḥ parihāra arthāni nityāni iti abhyupagamāt na anārabdha phala karma kṣaya arthāni yadi nāma anārabdha phala karma kṣaya arthani nityāni karmāṇi tathā api aśuddham eva kṣapayeyuḥ na śuddha virodha abhāvāt na hi iṣṭa phalasya karmaṇaḥ śuddha rūpa tvāt nityaiḥ virodhaḥ upapadyate

original: śuddhāśuddhayor hi virodho yuktaḥ / na ca karmahetūnāṃ kāmānā jñānābhāve nivṛttyasambhavād aśeṣakarmakṣayopapattiḥ / anātmavido hi kāmo 'nātmaphalaviṣayatvāt svātmani ca kāmānupapattir nityaprāptatvāt svayaṃ cātmā paraṃ brahmety uktam / nityānāṃ cākaraṇam abhāvas tataḥ pratyavāyānupapattir iti /
analyzed: śuddha aśuddhayoḥ hi virodhaḥ yuktaḥ na ca karma hetūnām kāmānām jñāna abhāve nivṛtti asambhavāt aśeṣa karma kṣaya upapattiḥ anātma vidaḥ hi kāmaḥ na ātma phala viṣaya tvāt svātmani ca kāma anupapattiḥ nitya prāpta tvāt svayam ca ātmā param brahma iti uktam nityānām ca akaraṇam abhāvaḥ tatas pratyavāya anupapattiḥ iti

original: ataḥ pūrvopacitaduritebhyaḥ prāpyamāṇāyāḥ pratyavāyakriyāyā nityākaraṇaṃ lakṣaṇam iti śatṛpratyayasya nānupapattiḥ akurvan vihita karma (ViP 3,18.39) iti / anyathābhāvādbhāvotpattir iti sarvapramāṇavyākopa iti / ato ayatnataḥ svātmany avasthānam ity anupapannam /
analyzed: atas pūrva upacita duritebhyaḥ prāpyamāṇāyāḥ pratyavāya kriyāyāḥ nitya akaraṇam lakṣaṇam iti śatṛ pratyayasya na anupapattiḥ akurvan iti anyathābhāvāt bhāva utpattiḥ iti sarva pramāṇa vyākopaḥ iti atas ayatnataḥ svātmani avasthānam iti anupapannam

original: yac coktataṃ niratiśayaprīteḥ svargaśabdavācyāyāḥ karmanimittatvāt karmārabhya eva mokṣa iti / tan na / nityavān mokṣasya / na hi nityaṃ kiñcid ārabhyate loke yad ārabdhaṃ tad anityam iti / ato na karmārabhyo mokṣaḥ / vidyāsahitānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nityārambhasāmarthyam iti cet / na / virodhāt / nityaṃ cārabhyata iti virudram /
analyzed: niratiśaya prīteḥ svarga śabda vācyāyāḥ karma nimitta tvāt karma ārabhyaḥ eva mokṣaḥ iti tat na nityavāt mokṣasya na hi nityam kiñcid ārabhyate loke yat ārabdham tat anityam iti atas na karma ārabhyaḥ mokṣaḥ vidyā sahitānām karmaṇām nitya ārambha sāmarthyam iti ced na virodhāt nityam ca ārabhyate iti virudram

original: yad dhi naṣṭaṃ tad eva notpadyata iti pradhvaṃsābhāvavannityo 'pi mokṣa ārabhya eveti cen na / mokṣasya bhāvarūpatvāt / pradhvaṃsābhāvo 'py ārabhyata iti na sambhavati, abhāvasya viśeṣābhāvād vikalpamātram etat / bhāvapratiyogī hy abhāvaḥ /
analyzed: yat hi naṣṭam tat eva na utpadyate iti pradhvaṃsa abhāva vat nityaḥ api mokṣaḥ ārabhyaḥ eva iti ced na mokṣasya bhāva rūpa tvāt pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ upi ārabhyate iti na sambhavati abhāvasya viśeṣa abhāvāt vikalpa mātram etat bhāva pratiyogī hi abhāvaḥ

original: yathā hy abhinno 'pi bhāvo ghaṭapaṭādibhir viśeṣyata abhinna eva ghaṭabhāvaḥ paṭabhāva iti, evaṃ nirviśeṣo 'py abhāvaḥ kriyāguṇayogād dravyādivadvikalpyate / na hy abhāva utpalādivadviśeṣaṇasahabhāvī / viśeṣaṇavattve bhāva eva syāt / vidyākarmakartur nityatvād vidyākarmasantānajanitamokṣanityatvam iti cen na /
analyzed: yathā hi abhinnaḥ api bhāvaḥ ghaṭa paṭa ādibhiḥ viśeṣyata abhinnaḥ eva ghaṭa bhāvaḥ paṭa bhāvaḥ iti evam nirviśeṣaḥ api abhāvaḥ kriyā guṇa yogāt dravya ādi vat vikalpyate na hi abhāvaḥ utpala ādi vat viśeṣaṇa sahabhāvī viśeṣaṇavat tve bhāvaḥ eva syāt vidyā karma kartuḥ nitya tvāt vidyā karma santāna janita mokṣa nitya tvam iti ced na

original: gaṃgāsrotovat kartṛtvasya duḥkharūpatvāt / kartṛtvoparame ca mokṣavicchedāt / tasmād avidyākāmakarmopādānahetu nivṛttau svātmany avasthānaṃ mokṣa iti, svayaṃ cātmā brahma tadvijñānād avidyānivṛttiḥ, iti brahmavidyārthopaniṣad ārabhyate /
analyzed: gaṃgā srotaḥ vat kartṛ tvasya duḥkha rūpa tvāt kartṛ tva uparame ca mokṣa vicchedāt tasmāt avidyā kāma karma upādāna hetu nivṛttau svātmani avasthānam mokṣaḥ iti svayam ca ātmā brahma tad vijñānāt avidyā nivṛttiḥ iti brahma vidyā artha upaniṣad ārabhyate

original: upaniṣad iti vidyocyate / tatsevināṃ garbhajanmajarādiniśātanāt tadavasādanād vā, brahmaṇo vopanigamayitṛtvād upaniṣaṇṇaṃ vāsyāṃ paraṃ śreya iti / tadarthatvād grantho 'py upaniṣat //
analyzed: upaniṣad iti vidyā ucyate tad sevinām garbha janma jarā ādi niśātanāt tad avasādanāt vā brahmaṇaḥ vā upanigamayitṛ tvāt upaniṣaṇṇam vā asyām param śreyaḥ iti tad artha tvāt granthaḥ u pi upaniṣad

original: oṃ śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ / śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā / śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ / śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ / namo brahmaṇe / namaste vāyo / tvameva pratyakṣaṃ brahmāsi / tvāmevapratyakṣaṃ brahma vadiṣyāmi / ṛtaṃ vadiṣyāmi / satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi / tanmāmavatu / tadvaktāramavatu / avatu mām / avatu vaktāram // oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ //
analyzed: om śam naḥ mitraḥ śam varuṇaḥ śam naḥ bhavatu aryamā śam naḥ indraḥ bṛhaspatiḥ śam naḥ viṣṇuḥ urukramaḥ namaḥ brahmaṇe namaḥ te vāyo tvam eva pratyakṣam brahma asi tvām eva pratyakṣam brahma vadiṣyāmi ṛtam vadiṣyāmi satyam vadiṣyāmi tat mām avatu tat vaktāram avatu avatu mām avatu vaktāram om śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ

analyzed: iti śikṣā adhyāye prathamaḥ nuvākaḥ

original: śaṃ sukhaṃ prāṇavṛtter ahnaś cābhimānī devatātmā mitro no 'smākaṃ bhavatu / tathaivāpānavṛtteḥ rātreś cābhimānī devatātmā varuṇaḥ / cakṣuṣyāditye cābhimāny aryamā / bale indraḥ / vāci buddhau ca bṛhaspatiḥ / viṣṇururukramo vistīrṇakramaḥ pādayor abhimānī / evam adhyātmadevatāḥ / śaṃ no bhavatv iti sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ /
analyzed: śam sukham prāṇa vṛtteḥ ahnaḥ ca abhimānī devatā ātmā mitraḥ naḥ smākam bhavatu tathā eva apāna vṛtteḥ rātreḥ ca abhimānī devatā ātmā varuṇaḥ cakṣuṣi āditye ca abhimānī aryamā bale indraḥ vāci buddhau ca bṛhaspatiḥ viṣṇuḥ urukramaḥ vistīrṇa kramaḥ pādayoḥ abhimānī evam adhyātma devatāḥ śam naḥ bhavatu iti sarvatra anuṣaṅgaḥ

original: tāsu hi sukhakṛtsu vidyāśravaṇadhāraṇopayogāpratibandhena bhaviṣyantīti tatsukhakartṛtvaṃ prārthyate — śaṃ no bhavatv iti / brahmavidyāvividiṣuṇā namaskārabrahmavadanakriye vāyuviṣaye brahmavidyopasargaśāntyarthaṃ kriyete / sarvakriyāphalānāṃ tadadhīnatvād brahma vāyus tasmai brahmaṇe namaḥ / prahvībhāvaṃ karomīti vākyaśeṣaḥ /
analyzed: tāsu hi sukha kṛtsu vidyā śravaṇa dhāraṇa upayoga a pratibandhena bhaviṣyanti iti tad sukha kartṛ tvam prārthyate śam naḥ bhavatu iti brahma vidyā vividiṣuṇā namaskāra brahma vadana kriye vāyu viṣaye brahma vidyā upasarga śānti artham kriyete sarva kriyā phalānām tad adhīna tvāt brahma vāyuḥ tasmai brahmaṇe namaḥ prahvībhāvam karomi iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

original: namaste tubhyaṃ he vāyo / namaskaromīti parokṣapratyakṣābhyāṃ vāyur evābhidhīyate / kiñca tvam eva cakṣurādyapekṣya bāhyaṃ sannikṛṣṭam avyavahitaṃ pratyakṣaṃ brahmāsi yasmāt tasmāt tvām eva pratyakṣaṃ brahma vadiṣyāmi / ṛtaṃ yathāśāstraṃ yathākartavyaṃ buddhau supariniścitam arthaṃ tvadadhīnatvāt tvām eva vadiṣyāmi /
analyzed: namaḥ te tubhyam he vāyo namaskaromi iti parokṣa pratyakṣābhyām vāyuḥ eva abhidhīyate kiñca tvam eva cakṣuḥ ādi apekṣya bāhyam sannikṛṣṭam avyavahitam pratyakṣam brahma asi yasmāt tasmāt tvām eva pratyakṣam brahma vadiṣyāmi ṛtam yathāśāstram yathā kartavyam buddhau su pariniścitam artham tvad adhīna tvāt tvām eva vadiṣyāmi

original: satyam iti sa eva vākkāyābhyāṃ sampādyamānaḥ, so 'pi tvadadhīna eva sampādyate iti tvām eva satyaṃ vadiṣyāmi / tatsarvātmakaṃ vāyvākhyaṃ brahma mayaivaṃ stutaṃ sanmāṃ vidyārthinām avatuvidyā saṃyojanena / tad eva brahma vaktāram ācāryaṃ ca vaktṛtvasāmarthyasaṃyojanenāvatu / avatu mām avatu vaktāram iti punarvacanamādarārtham /
analyzed: satyam iti saḥ eva vāc kāyābhyām sampādyamānaḥ saḥ u pi tvad adhīnaḥ eva sampādyate iti tvām eva satyam vadiṣyāmi tat sarva ātmakam vāyu ākhyam brahma mayā evam stutam sat mām vidyā arthinām avatu vidyā saṃyojanena tat eva brahma vaktāram ācāryam ca vaktṛ tva sāmarthya saṃyojanena avatu avatu mām avatu vaktāram iti punarvacanam ādara artham

analyzed: om śīkṣām vyākhyāsyāmaḥ varṇaḥ svaraḥ mātrā balam sāma santānaḥ iti uktaḥ śīkṣā adhyāyaḥ iti dvitīyaḥ nuvādakaḥ

original: arthajñānapradhānatvād upaniṣado granthapāṭhe yatnoparamo mā bhūd iti śīkṣādhyāya ārabhyate — śikṣā śikṣyate 'nayeti varṇādyuccāraṇalakṣaṇam / śikṣyanta iti vā śikṣā varṇādayaḥ / śikṣaiva śīkṣā / dairdhyaṃ chāndasam / tāṃ śīkṣāṃ vyākhyāsyāmo vispaṣṭamā samantāt prakathayiṣyāmaḥ cakṣiṅo vā khyāñādiṣṭasya vyāṅpūrvasya vyaktatvāt karmaṇa etad rūpam /
analyzed: artha jñāna pradhāna tvāt upaniṣadaḥ grantha pāṭhe yatna uparamaḥ mā bhūt iti śīkṣā adhyāyaḥ ārabhyate śikṣā śikṣyate naya iti varṇa ādi uccāraṇa lakṣaṇam śikṣyante iti vā śikṣā varṇa ādayaḥ śikṣā eva śīkṣā dairdhyam chāndasam tām śīkṣām vyākhyāsyāmaḥ vispaṣṭam ā samantāt prakathayiṣyāmaḥ cakṣiṅaḥ vā khyāñ ādiṣṭasya vyāṅ pūrvasya vyakta tvāt karmaṇaḥ etat rūpam

original: tatra varṇo 'kārādiḥ / svara udāttādiḥ / mātrā hrasvādyāḥ / balaṃ prayatnaviśeṣaḥ / sāma varṇānāṃ madhyam avṛttyoccāraṇaṃ samatā / santānaḥ santatiḥ, saṃhitety arthaḥ / eṣa hi śikṣitavyo 'rthaḥ śikṣā yasminn adhyāye so 'yaṃ śīkṣādhyāya ity evam ukta uditaḥ / ukta ity upasaṃhārārthaḥ //
analyzed: tatra kāra ādiḥ svaraḥ udātta ādiḥ mātrāḥ hrasva ādyāḥ balam prayatna viśeṣaḥ sāma varṇānām madhyam avṛttyā uccāraṇam samatā santānaḥ santatiḥ saṃhitā iti arthaḥ eṣa hi śikṣitavyaḥ rthaḥ śikṣā yasmin adhyāye saḥ yam śīkṣā adhyāyaḥ iti evam uktaḥ uditaḥ uktaḥ iti upasaṃhāra arthaḥ

original: iti dvitīyo 'nuvākaḥ // 2 //
analyzed: iti dvitīyaḥ nuvākaḥ 2

original: saha nau yaśaḥ / saha nau brahmavarcasam / athātaḥ saṃhitāyā upaniṣidaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ / pañcasvadhikaraṇeṣu / adhilokamadhijyautiṣamadhividyamadhiprajamadhyātmam / tā mahāsaṃhitāyā ityācakṣate / athādhilokam / pṛthivī pūrvarūpam / dyauruttararūpam / ākāśaḥ sandhiḥ //

analyzed: aham vṛkṣasya rerivā iti svādhyāya arthaḥ mantra āmnāyaḥ svādhyāyaḥ ca vidyā utpattaye prakaraṇāt vidyā artham hi idam prakaraṇam na ca anya artha tvam avagamyate svādhyāyena ca viśuddha sattvasya vidyā utpattiḥ avakalpyate aham vṛkṣasya uccheda ātmakasya saṃsāra vṛkṣasya rerivā prerathita antaryāmi ātmanā kīrtiḥ khyātiḥ gireḥ pṛṣṭham iva ucchritā mama

original: ūrdhvapavitra ūrdhvaṃ kāraṇaṃ pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ jñānaprakāśyaṃ paramaṃ brahma yasya sarvātmano mama, so 'ham ūrdhvapavitraḥ / vājinīva vājavatīva / vājamannaṃ tadvati savitarīty arthaḥ / yathā savitaryamṛtamātmatattvaṃ viśuddhaṃ prasiddhaṃ śrutismṛtiśatebhyaḥ, evaṃ svamṛtaṃ śobhanaṃ viśuddham ātmatattvam asmi bhavāmi /
analyzed: ūrdhva pavitraḥ ūrdhvam kāraṇam pavitram pāvanam jñāna prakāśyam paramam brahma yasya sarvātmanaḥ mama saḥ ham ūrdhva pavitraḥ vājinī iva vājavatī iva vājam annam tadvati savitari iti arthaḥ yathā savitari amṛtam ātma tattvam viśuddham prasiddham śruti smṛti śatebhyaḥ evam su amṛtam śobhanam viśuddham ātma tattvam asmi bhavāmi

original: draviṇaṃ dhanaṃ savarcasaṃ dīptimat tad evātmatattvam asmīty anuvartate / brahmajñānaṃ vātmatattvaprakāśakatvāt savarcasam / draviṇam iva draviṇaṃ mokṣasukhahetutvāt / asmin pakṣe prāptaṃ mayety adhyāhāraḥ kartavyaḥ / sumedhāḥ śobhanā medhā sarvajñalakṣaṇā yasya mama so 'haṃ sumedhāḥ / saṃsārasthityutpattisaṃhārakauśalayogāt sumedhastvam /
analyzed: draviṇam dhanam savarcasam dīptimat tat eva ātma tattvam asmi iti anuvartate brahma jñānam vā ātma tattva prakāśaka tvāt savarcasam draviṇam iva draviṇam mokṣa sukha hetu tvāt asmin pakṣe prāptam mayā iti adhyāhāraḥ kartavyaḥ sumedhāḥ śobhanā medhā sarvajña lakṣaṇā yasya mama saḥ ham sumedhāḥ saṃsāra sthiti utpatti saṃhāra kauśala yogāt sumedhaḥ tvam

original: ata evāmṛto 'maraṇadharmākṣito 'kṣīṇo 'vyaya akṣito vā / amṛtena vokṣitaḥ siktaḥ / amṛtokṣito 'ham ity ādi brāhmaṇam / ity evaṃ triśaṅka ṛṣer brahmabhūtasya brahmavido vedānuvacanaṃ, vedo vedanam ātmaikatvavijñānaṃ, tasya prāptim anu vacanaṃ vedānuvacanam /
analyzed: atas eva amṛtaḥ kṣīṇaḥ vyaya akṣitaḥ vā amṛtena vā ukṣitaḥ siktaḥ amṛta ukṣitaḥ ham iti ādi brāhmaṇam iti evam triśaṅkaḥ ṛṣeḥ brahma bhūtasya brahma vidaḥ veda anuvacanam vedaḥ vedanam ātma eka tva vijñānam tasya prāptim anu vacanam veda anuvacanam

original: ātmanaḥ kṛtakṛtyatākhyāpanārthaṃ vāmadevavat triśaṅkunārṣeṇa darśanena dṛṣṭī mantrāmnāya ātmavidyāprakāśaka ity arthaḥ / asya ca japo vidyotpatyartho 'vagamyate / ṛtaṃ cety ādidharmopanyāsād anantaraṃ ca vedānuvacanapāṭhād etad avagamyate /

original: vedamanūcyācāryontevāsinamanuśāsti / satyaṃ vada / dharmaṃ cara / svādhyāyānmā pramadaḥ / ācāryāya priyaṃ dhanamāhṛtya prajātantuṃ mā vyavacchetsīḥ / satyānna pramaditavyam / dharmānna pramaditavyam / kuśalānna pramaditavyam / bhūtyaina pramaditavyam / svādhyāyapravacanābhyāṃ na pramaditavyam //

original: vakṣyati ca tapasā brahma vijijñāsasva (TaittU 3,3.1-3,5.1) iti / ato vidyotpattyartham anuṣṭheyāni karmāṇi / anuśāstīty anuśāsanaśabdād anuśāsanātikrame hi doṣotpattiḥ / prāg upanyāsāc ca karmaṇāṃ kevalabrahmavidyārambhāc ca pūrva karmāṇy upanyastāni /

analyzed: uditāyām ca brahmavidyāyām abhayam pratiṣṭhām vindate  taittu 271 na vibheti kutaścana taittu kim aham sādhu na akaravam Taittu iti evam ādinā karma naiṣkiñcanyam darśayiṣyati atas vagamyate pūrva upacita durita kṣaya dvāreṇa vidyā utpatti arthāni karmāṇi iti mantra varṇāt ca avidyayā mṛtyu tīrtvā vidyayā amṛtam aśnute iti

original: ṛtādīnāṃ pūrvatropadeśa ānarthakyaparihārārthaḥ / iha tu jñānotpattyarthatvāt kartavyaniyamārthaḥ / vedam anūcyādhyāpy ācāryo 'ntevāsinaṃ śiṣyam anuśāsti granthagrahaṇād anupaścāc chāsti tadarthe grāhayatīty arthaḥ / ato 'vagamyate 'dhītavedasya dharmajijñāsāmakṛtvā gurukulān na samāvartitavyam iti / buddhvā karmāṇi cārabhet iti smṛteś ca /
analyzed: ṛta ādīnām pūrvatra upadeśaḥ ānarthakya parihāra arthaḥ iha tu jñāna utpatti artha tvāt kartavya niyama arthaḥ vedam anūcya adhyāpī ācāryaḥ ntevāsinam śiṣyam anuśāsti grantha grahaṇāt anu paścāt śāsti tad arthe grāhayati iti arthaḥ atas vagamyate dhīta vedasya dharma jijñāsām a kṛtvā guru kulāt na samāvartitavyam iti buddhvā karmāṇi ca ārabhet iti smṛteḥ ca

original: katham anuśāstīty āha satyaṃ vada yathāpramāṇāvagataṃ vaktavyaṃ tadvada / tadvad dharmaṃ cara / dharma ity anuṣṭheyānāṃ sāmānyavacanaṃ, satyādiviśeṣanirdeśāt / svādhyāyād adhyayanān mā pramadaḥ pramādaṃ mā kārṣīḥ /
analyzed: katham anuśāsti iti āha satyam vada yathā pramāṇa avagatam vaktavyam tat vada tadvat dharmam cara dharme iti anuṣṭheyānām sāmānya vacanam satya ādi viśeṣa nirdeśāt svādhyāyāt adhyayanāt mā pramadaḥ pramādam mā kārṣīḥ

original: acāryāya ācāryārthaṃ priyam iṣṭaṃ dhanam āhṛtyānīya dattvā vidyāniṣkrayārtham ācāryeṇa cānujñāto 'nurūpān dārān āhṛtya prajātantu prajāsantānaṃ mā vyavacchetsīḥ, prajāsantater vicchittirnakartavyā / anutpadyamāne 'pi putre putrakāmyādikarmaṇā tadutpattau yatnaḥ kartavya ity abhiprāyaḥ / prajāprajananaprajātitrayanirdeśasāmarthyāt /
analyzed: acāryāya ācārya artham priyam iṣṭam dhanam āhṛtya ānīya dattvā vidyā niṣkraya artham ācāryeṇa ca anujñātaḥ nurūpān dārān āhṛtya prajā tantu prajā santānam mā vyavacchetsīḥ prajā santateḥ vicchittiḥ na kartavyā an utpadyamāne pi putre putra kāmyā ādi karmaṇā tad utpattau yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ prajā prajanana prajāti traya nirdeśa sāmarthyāt

original: anyathā prajananaś cety etad ekam evāvakṣyat / satyān na pramaditavyaṃ pramādo na kartavyaḥ / satyāc ca pramadanam anṛtaprasaṅgaḥ / pramādaśabdasāmarthyāt / vismṛtyāpy anṛtaṃ na vaktavyam ity arthaḥ / anyathāsatyavadanapratiṣedha eva syāt / dharmān na pramaditavyam /
analyzed: anyathā prajananaḥ ca iti etat ekam eva avakṣyat satyāt na pramaditavyam pramādaḥ na kartavyaḥ satyāt ca pramadanam anṛta prasaṅgaḥ pramāda śabda sāmarthyāt vismṛtya api anṛtam na vaktavyam iti arthaḥ anyathā asatya vadana pratiṣedhaḥ eva syāt dharmāt na pramaditavyam

original: dharmaśabdasyānuṣṭheyaviṣayatvād ananuṣṭhānaṃ pramādaḥ, sa na kartavyaḥ anuṣṭhātavya eva dharma iti yāvat / evaṃ kuśalād ātmarakṣārthāt karmaṇo na pramaditavyam / bhūtir vibhūtis tasyai bhūtyai bhūtyarthān maṅgalayuktāt karmaṇo na pramaditavyam / svādhyāyapravacanābhyāṃ na pramaditavyam /
analyzed: dharma śabdasya anuṣṭheya viṣaya tvāt ananuṣṭhānam pramādaḥ sa na kartavyaḥ anuṣṭhātavyaḥ eva dharmaḥ iti yāvat evam kuśalāt ātma rakṣā arthāt karmaṇaḥ na pramaditavyam bhūtiḥ vibhūtiḥ tasyai bhūtyai bhūti arthāt maṅgala yuktāt karmaṇaḥ na pramaditavyam svādhyāya pravacanābhyām na pramaditavyam

original: svādhyāyo 'dhyayanaṃ pravacanamadhyāpanaṃ tābhyāṃ na pramaditavyam / te hi niyamena kartavye ity arthaḥ / tathā devapitṛkāryābhyāṃ na pramaditavyam / daivapitrye karmaṇī kartavye / mātṛdevo mātā devo yasya sa tvaṃ mātṛdevo bhava syāḥ / evaṃ pitṛdeva ācāryadevo 'tithidevo bhava / devatāvad upāsyā eta ity arthaḥ /
analyzed: svādhyāyaḥ dhyayanam pravacanam adhyāpanam tābhyām na pramaditavyam te hi niyamena kartavye iti arthaḥ tathā deva pitṛ kāryābhyām na pramaditavyam daiva pitrye karmaṇī kartavye mātṛ devaḥ mātā devaḥ yasya sa tvam mātṛ devaḥ bhava syāḥ evam pitṛ devaḥ ācārya devaḥ tithi devaḥ bhava devatāvat upāsyāḥ ete iti arthaḥ

original: yāny api cānyānyanavadyānyaninditāni śiṣṭācāralakṣaṇāni karmāṇi tāni sevitavyāni kartavyāni tvayā / no na kartavyānītarāṇi sāvadyāni śiṣṭkṛtāny api / yāny asmākam ācāryāṇāṃ sucaritāni śobhanacaritāny āmrāyādyāviruddhāni tāny eva tvayopāsyāny adṛṣṭārthāny anuṣṭheyāni, niyamena kartavyānīti yāvat / no itarāṇi viparītāny ācāryakṛtāny api /
analyzed: yāni api ca anyāni anavadyāni aninditāni śiṣṭa ācāra lakṣaṇāni karmāṇi tāni sevitavyāni kartavyāni tvayā no na kartavyāni itarāṇi sāvadyāni śiṣṭkṛtāni api yāni asmākam ācāryāṇām su caritāni śobhana caritāni āmrāya ādya aviruddhāni tāni eva tvayā upāsyāni adṛṣṭa arthāni anuṣṭheyāni niyamena kartavyāni iti yāvat no itarāṇi viparītāni ācārya kṛtāni api

analyzed: atas sya anitya tvam paratantra tā ca na sva rūpa a vyatirekeṇa kārya tva upacārāt ātmanaḥ sva rūpam jñaptiḥ na tatas vyatiricyata atas nityā eva tathā api buddheḥ upādhi lakṣaṇāyāḥ cakṣuḥ ādi dvāraiḥ viṣaya ākāreṇa pariṇāminyāḥ ye śabda ādi ākāra avabhāsāḥ te ātma vijñānasya viṣaya bhūte utpadyamānāḥ eva ātma vijñānena vyāptāḥ utpadyante

original: tasmād ātmavijñānāvabhāsyāś ca te vijñānaśabdavācyāś ca dhātvarthabhūtā ātmana eva dharmā vikriyārūpā ity avivekibhiḥ parikalpyante / yat tu brahmaṇo vijñānaṃ tatsavitṛprakāśavad agnyuṣṇatvavac ca brahmasvarūpāvyatiriktaṃ svarūpam eva tat / na tatkāraṇāntarasavyapekṣam /
analyzed: tasmāt ātma vijñāna avabhāsyāḥ ca te vijñāna śabda vācyāḥ ca dhātvartha bhūtāḥ ātmanaḥ eva dharmāḥ vikriyā rūpāḥ iti avivekibhiḥ parikalpyante yat tu brahmaṇaḥ vijñānam tat savitṛ prakāśa vat agni uṣṇa tva vat ca brahma svarūpa avyatiriktam svarūpam eva tat na tat kāraṇa antara savyapekṣam

original: nityasvarūpatvāt sarvabhāvānāṃ ca tenāvibhaktadeśakālatvāt kālākāśādikāraṇatvāc ca niratiśayasūkṣmatvāc ca / na tasyānyad avijñeyaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vyavahitaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ bhūtaṃ bhavad bhaviṣyad vāsti / tasmāt sarvajñaṃ tadbrahma / mantravarṇāś ca — apāṇipādo javano grahītā paśyaty acakṣuḥ sa śṛṇoty akarṇaḥ /
analyzed: nitya svarūpa tvāt sarva bhāvānām ca tena avibhakta deśa kāla tvāt kāla ākāśa ādi kāraṇa tvāt ca niratiśaya sūkṣma tvāt ca na tasya anyat avijñeyam sūkṣmam vyavahitam viprakṛṣṭam bhūtam bhavat bhaviṣyat vā asti tasmāt sarvajñam tat brahma mantra varṇāḥ ca a pāṇi pādaḥ javanaḥ grahītā paśyati a cakṣuḥ sa śṛṇoti a karṇaḥ

original: sa vetti vedyaṃ na ca tasyāsti vettā tam āhur agryaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam (ŚvU 3,19) iti / na hi vijñātur vijñāter viparilopo vidyate 'vināśitvān na tu tadūdvitīyam asti (BĀU 4,3.30) ity ādiśruteś ca / vijñātṛsvarūpāvyatirekāt karaṇādinimittānapekṣatvāś ca brahmaṇo jñānasvarūpatve 'pi nityatvaprasiddhiḥ / ato naiva dhātvarthas tadakriyārūpatvāt /
analyzed: sa vetti vedyam na ca tasya asti vettā tam āhuḥ agryam puruṣam mahāntam śvU iti na hi vijñātuḥ vijñāteḥ viparilopaḥ vidyate vināśi tvāt na tu  iti ādi śruteḥ ca vijñātṛ svarūpa avyatirekāt karaṇa ādi nimitta anapekṣa tvāt SBNe ca brahmaṇaḥ jñāna svarūpa tve pi nitya tva prasiddhiḥ atas na eva dhātvarthaḥ tad akriyā rūpa tvāt

original: ata eva ca na jñānakartṛ, tasmād eva ca na jñānaśabdavācyam api tadbrahma / tathāpi tadābhāsavācakena buddhidharmaviṣayeṇa / jñānaśabdena tal lakṣyate, na tūcyate, śabdapravṛttihetujātyādidharmarahitatvāt / tathā satyaśabdenāpi / sarvaviśeṣapratyastamitasvarūpatvād brahmaṇo bāhyasattāsāmānyaviṣayeṇa satyaśabdena lakṣyate satyaṃ brahmeti /
analyzed: atas eva ca na jñāna kartṛ tasmāt eva ca na jñāna śabda vācyam api tat brahma tathā api tad ābhāsa vācakena buddhi dharma viṣayeṇa jñāna śabdena tat lakṣyate na tu ucyate śabda pravṛtti hetu jāti ādi dharma rahita tvāt tathā satya śabdena api sarva viśeṣa pratyasta mita svarūpa tvāt brahmaṇaḥ bāhya sattā sāmānya viṣayeṇa satya śabdena lakṣyate satyam brahma iti

original: na tu satyaśabdavācyam eva brahma / evaṃ satyādiśabdā itaretarasannidhānād anyonyaniyamyaniyāmakāḥ santaḥ satyādiśabdavācyāt tannivartakā brahmaṇo, lakṣaṇārthāś ca bhavantīti / ataḥ siddhaṃ yato vāco nivartante / aprāpya manasā saha (TaittU 2,4.1; 2,9.1) anirukto 'nilayane (TaittU 2,7.1) iti cāvācyatvaṃ, nīlotpalavadavākyārthatvaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ /
analyzed: na tu satya śabda vācyam eva brahma evam satya ādi śabdāḥ itaretara sannidhānāt anyonya niyamya niyāmakāḥ santaḥ satya ādi śabda vācyāt tad nivartakāḥ brahmaṇaḥ lakṣaṇa arthāḥ ca bhavanti iti atas siddham yatas vācaḥ nivartante a prāpya manasā saha TaittU aniruktaḥ nilayane TaittU iti ca avācya tvam nīlotpala vat avākya artha tvam ca brahmaṇaḥ

original: tad yathāvyākhyātaṃ brahma yo veda vijānāti nihitaṃ sthitaṃ guhāyām / gūhateḥ saṃvaraṇārthasya nigūḍhā asyāṃ jñānakṣeyajñātṛpadārthā iti guhā buddhiḥ gūḍhāvasyāṃ bhogāpavargau puruṣārthāv iti vā, tasyāṃ parame prakṛṣṭe vyomanvyomnyākāśe 'vyākṛtākhye / tad dhi paramaṃ vyāma etasmin khalv akṣare gārgy ākāśaḥ (BĀU 3,8.11) ity akṣarasannikarṣāt /
analyzed: tat yathā vyākhyātam brahma yaḥ veda vijānāti nihitam sthitam guhāyām gūhateḥ saṃvaraṇa arthasya nigūḍhāḥ asyām jñāna kṣeya jñātṛ padārthāḥ iti guhā buddhiḥ gūḍhau asyām bhoga apavargau puruṣa arthau iti vā tasyām parame prakṛṣṭe vyoman vyomni ākāśe vyākṛta ākhye tat hi paramam vyāme etad SLNe khalu akṣare gārgi ākāśaḥ iti akṣara sannikarṣāt

original: guhāyāṃ vyomnīti vā sāmānādhikaraṇyād avyākṛtākāśam eva guhā, tatrāpi nigūḍhāḥ sarve padārthās triṣu kāleṣu, kāraṇatvāt sūkṣmataratvāc ca / tasminn antarnihitaṃ brahma / hārdam eva tu paramaṃ vyometi nyāyyaṃ, vijñānāṅgatve vyomno vivakṣitatvāt /
analyzed: guhāyām vyomni iti vā sāmānādhikaraṇyāt avyākṛta ākāśam eva guhā tatra api nigūḍhāḥ sarve padārthāḥ triṣu kāleṣu kāraṇa tvāt sūkṣmatara tvāt ca tasmin antar nihitam brahma hārdam eva tu paramam vyoma iti nyāyyam vijñāna aṅga tve vyomnaḥ vivakṣita tvāt

original: yo vai sa bahirdhā puruṣād ākāśo yo vai so 'ntaḥ puruṣa ākāśo yo 'yam antarhṛdaya ākāśaḥ (ChU 3,12.7) iti śrutyantarāt prasiddhaṃ hārdasya vyomnaḥ paramatvam / tasmin hārde vyomni yā buddhir guhā tasyāṃ nihitaṃ brahma tadvyāvṛttyā viviktatayopalabhyata iti / na hy anyathā viśiṣṭadeśakālasambandho 'sti brahmaṇaḥ sarvagatvān nirviśeṣatvāc ca /
analyzed: yaḥ vai sa bahirdhā puruṣāt ākāśaḥ yaḥ vai saḥ ntar puruṣaḥ ākāśaḥ yaḥ yam antar hṛdaye ākāśaḥ iti śruti antarāt prasiddham hārdasya vyomnaḥ parama tvam tasmin hārde vyomni yā buddhiḥ guhā tasyām nihitam brahma tad vyāvṛttyā vivikta tayā upalabhyate iti na hi anyathā viśiṣṭa deśa kāla sambandhaḥ u sti brahmaṇaḥ sarvaga tvāt nirviśeṣa tvāt ca

original: sa evaṃ brahma vijānan kim ity āha — aśnute bhuṅkte sarvān niravaśeṣān kāmān kāmyabhogān ity arthaḥ / kim asmad ādivat putrasvargādīn paryāyeṇa? nety āha saha yugapad ekakṣaṇopārūḍhān evaikayopalabdhyā savitṛprakāśavan nityayā brahmatvarūpāvyatiriktayā, yām avocāma satyaṃ jñānam anantam (TaittU 2,1.1) iti / etat tad ucyate — brahmaṇā saheti /
analyzed: saḥ evam brahma vijānan kim iti āha aśnute bhuṅkte sarvān niravaśeṣān kāmān kāmya bhogān iti arthaḥ kim asmat ādi vat putra svarga ādīn paryāyeṇa na iti āha saha yugapad eka kṣaṇa upārūḍhān eva ekayā upalabdhyā savitṛ prakāśa vat nityayā brahmatva rūpa a vyatiriktayā yām avocāma satyam jñānam anantam iti etat tat ucyate brahmaṇā saha iti

original: brahmabhūto vidvān brahmasvarūpeṇaiva sarvān kāmān sahāśnute, na yathopādhikṛtena svarūpeṇātmano jalasūryakādivat pratibimbabhūtena sāṃsārikeṇa dharmādinimittāpekṣāṃś cakṣurādikaraṇāpekṣāṃś ca sarvān kāmān paryāyeṇāśnute lokaḥ /
analyzed: brahma bhūtaḥ vidvān brahma sva rūpeṇa eva sarvān kāmān saha aśnute na yathā upādhi kṛtena sva rūpeṇa ātmanaḥ jala sūryaka ādi vat pratibimba bhūtena sāṃsārikeṇa dharma ādi nimitta apekṣān cakṣuḥ ādi karaṇa apekṣān ca sarvān kāmān paryāyeṇa aśnute lokaḥ

original: kathaṃ tarhi, yathoktena prakāreṇa sarvajñena sarvagatena sarvātmanā nityabrahmātmasvarūpeṇa dharmādinimittān apekṣāṃś cakṣurādikaraṇanirapekṣāṃś ca sarvān kāmān sahaivāśnuta ity arthaḥ vipaścitā medhāvinā sarvajñena / tadvi vaipaścityaṃ yatsarvajñatvaṃ, tena sarvajñasvarūpeṇa brahmaṇāśnuta iti / itiśabdo mantraparisamāptyarthaḥ /
analyzed: katham tarhi yathā uktena prakāreṇa sarvajñena sarvagatena sarvātmanā nitya brahma ātma svarūpeṇa dharma ādi nimittān apekṣān cakṣuḥ ādi karaṇa nirapekṣān ca sarvān kāmān saha eva aśnute iti arthaḥ vipaścitā medhāvinā sarvajñena tat vi vaipaścityam yat sarvajña tvam tena sarvajña svarūpeṇa brahmaṇā aśnute iti iti śabdaḥ mantra parisamāpti arthaḥ

original: sarva eva vallyartho brahmavid āpnoti param (TaittU 2,1.1) iti brāhmaṇavākyena sūtritaḥ / sa ca sūtrato 'rthaḥ saṃkṣepato mantreṇa vyākhyātaḥ / punas tasyaiva vistareṇārthanirṇayaḥ kartavya ity uttaras tadvivṛttisthānīyo grantha ārabhyate — tasmād vā etasmād ity ādiḥ /
analyzed: sarvaḥ eva vallī arthaḥ brahma vid āpnoti param SANe iti brāhmaṇa vākyena sūtritaḥ sa ca sūtrataḥ rthaḥ saṃkṣepataḥ mantreṇa vyākhyātaḥ punar tasya eva vistareṇa artha nirṇayaḥ kartavyaḥ iti uttaraḥ tad vivṛtti sthānīyaḥ granthaḥ ārabhyate tasmāt vai etasmāt iti ādiḥ

original: tatra ca satyaṃ jñānam anantaṃ brahma (TaittU 2,1.1) ity uktataṃ mantrādau, tat kathaṃ satyam anantaṃ cety ata āha / tatra trividhaṃ hy ānantyaṃ deśataḥ kālato vastutaś ceti / tad yathā deśato 'nanta ākāśo, na hi deśatas tasya paricchedo 'sti / na tu kālataś cānantyaṃ vastutaś cākāśasya / kasmāt kāryatvāt /
analyzed: tatra ca satyam jñānam anantam brahma iti mantra ādau tat katham satyam anantam ca iti atas āha tatra trividham hi ānantyam deśataḥ kālataḥ vastutas ca iti tat yathā deśataḥ nantaḥ ākāśaḥ na hi deśataḥ tasya paricchedaḥ sti na tu kālataḥ ca ānantyam vastutas ca ākāśasya kasmāt kārya tvāt

original: naivaṃ brahmaṇa ākāśavat kālato 'py antavattvam akāryatvāt / kārya hi vastu kālena paricchidyate / akāryaṃ ca brahma / tasmāt kālato 'py anantam / tathā vastutaḥ / kathaṃ punar vastuta anantyaṃ sarvānanyatvāt / bhinnaṃ hi vastu vastvantarasyānto bhavati / vastvantarabuddhir hi prasaktād vastvantarān nivartate /
analyzed: na evam brahmaṇaḥ ākāśa vat antavat tvam akārya tvāt kārya hi vastu kālena paricchidyate akāryam ca brahma tasmāt kālataḥ upi anantam tathā vastutas katham punar vastutaḥ ānantyam sarva ananya tvāt bhinnam hi vastu vastu antarasya antaḥ bhavati vastu antara buddhiḥ hi prasaktāt vastu antarāt nivartate

original: yato yasya buddher nivṛttiḥ sa tasyāntaḥ / tad yathā gotvabuddhir aśvatvād vinivartata ity aśvatvāntaṃ gotvam ity antavad eva bhavati / sa cānto bhinneṣu vastuṣu dṛṣṭo, naivaṃ brahmaṇo bhedaḥ / ato vastuto 'py ānantyam / kathaṃ punaḥ sarvānanyatvaṃ brahmaṇa ity ucyate, sarvavastukāraṇatvāt / sarveṣāṃ hi vastūnāṃ kālākāśādīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ brahma /
analyzed: yatas yasya buddheḥ nivṛttiḥ sa tasya antaḥ tat yathā go tva buddhiḥ aśva tvāt vinivartate iti aśva tva antam go tvam iti antavat eva bhavati sa ca antaḥ bhinneṣu vastuṣu dṛṣṭaḥ na evam brahmaṇaḥ bhedaḥ atas ānantyam katham punar sarva ananya tvam brahmaṇaḥ iti ucyate sarva vastu kāraṇa tvāt sarveṣām hi vastūnām kāla ākāśa ādīnām kāraṇam brahma

original: kāryāpekṣayāvastuto 'ntavattvam iti cen na / anṛtatvāt kāryāvastunaḥ / na hi kāraṇa vyatirekeṇa kāryaṃ nāma vastuto 'sti / yataḥ kāraṇabuddhir vinivarteta / vācārambhaṇaṃ vikāro nāmadheyaṃ mṛttikety eva satyaṃ (ChU 6,4.1) evaṃ sad eva satyam iti śrutyantarāt / tasmād ākāśādikāraṇatvād deśatas tāvad anantaṃ brahma /
analyzed: kārya apekṣayā avastutas iti ced na anṛta tvāt kārya avastunaḥ na hi kāraṇa vyatirekeṇa kāryam nāma vastutas sti yatas kāraṇa buddhiḥ vinivarteta vācā ārambhaṇam vikāraḥ nāmadheyam mṛttikā iti eva satyam evam  sat eva  satyam iti  śruti antarāt tasmāt ākāśa ādi kāraṇa tvāt deśataḥ tāvat anantam brahma

original: ākāśo hy ananta iti prasiddhaṃ deśataḥ, tasya cedaṃ kāraṇaṃ, tasmāt siddhaṃ deśata ātmana ānantyam / na hy asarvagatāt sarvagatam utpadyamanaṃ loke kiñcid dṛśyate / ato niratiśayam ātmana ānantyaṃ deśataḥ, tathākāryatvāt kālataḥ, tadbhinnavastvantarābhāvāc ca vastutaḥ / ata eva niratiśayasatyavam /
analyzed: ākāśaḥ hi anantaḥ iti prasiddham deśataḥ tasya ca idam kāraṇam tasmāt siddham deśataḥ ātmanaḥ ānantyam na hi asarvagatāt sarvagatam utpadyamanam loke kiñcid dṛśyate atas niratiśayam ātmanaḥ ānantyam deśataḥ tathā akārya tvāt kālataḥ tad bhinna vastu antara abhāvāt ca vastutaḥ atas eva niratiśaya satya vam as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā as tathā

original: tasmād iti mūlavākyasūtritaṃ brahma parāmṛśyate / etasmād iti mantravākyeṇānantaraṃ yathālakṣitam / yad brahmādau brāhmaṇavākyena sūtritaṃ, yac ca satyaṃ jñānam anantaṃ brahmety anantaram (TaittU 2,1.1) eva lakṣitaṃ, tasmād etasmād brahmaṇa ātmana ātmaśabdavācyāt / ātmā hi tatsarvasya tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā (ChU 6,8.16) iti śrutyantarāt /
analyzed: tasmāt iti mūlavākya sūtritam brahma parāmṛśyate etasmāt iti mantra vākyeṇa anantaram yathā lakṣitam yat brahma ādau brāhmaṇa vākyena sūtritam yat ca satyam jñānam anantam brahma iti anantaram eva lakṣitam tasmāt etasmāt brahmaṇaḥ ātmanaḥ ātma śabda vācyāt ātmā hi tat sarvasya tat satyam saḥ ātmā Cp iti śruti antarāt

original: ato brahmātmā / tasmād etasmād brahmaṇa ātmasvarūpād ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥ samutpannaḥ / ākāśo nāma śabdaguṇo 'vakāśakaro mūrtadravyāṇām / tasmād ākāśāt svena sparśaguṇena pūrveṇa ca ākāśaguṇena śabdena dviguṇo vāyuḥ / sambhūta ity anuvartate / vāyoś ca svena rūpaguṇena pūrvābhyāṃ ca triguṇo 'gniḥ sambhūtaḥ /
analyzed: atas brahma ātmā tasmāt etasmāt brahmaṇaḥ ātma svarūpāt ākāśaḥ sambhūtaḥ samutpannaḥ ākāśaḥ nāma śabda guṇaḥ vakāśa karaḥ mūrta dravyāṇām tasmāt ākāśāt svena sparśa guṇena pūrveṇa ca ākāśa guṇena śabdena dviguṇaḥ vāyuḥ sambhūtaḥ iti anuvartate vāyoḥ ca svena rūpa guṇena pūrvābhyām ca triguṇaḥ gniḥ sambhūtaḥ

original: agneś ca svena rasaguṇena pūrvaiś ca tribhiś caturguṇā āpaḥ sambhūtāḥ / adbhyaḥ svena gandhaguṇena pūrvaiś caturbhiḥ pañcaguṇā pṛthivī sambhūtā / pṛthivyā oṣadhayaḥ / oṣadhībhyo 'nnam / annādretorūpeṇa pariṇatāt puruṣaḥ śiraḥpāṇyādyākṛtimān /

original: sa vā eṣa puruṣo 'nnarasamayo 'nnarasavikāraḥ, puruṣākṛtibhāvitaṃ hi sarvebhyo 'ṅgebhyas tejaḥ sambhūtaṃ reto bījaṃ, tasmād yo jāyate so 'pi tathā puruṣākṛtir eva syāt / sarvajātiṣu jāyamānānāṃ janakākṛtiniyam adarśanāt / sarveṣām apy annarasavikāratve brahmavaṃśatve cāviśiṣṭe kasmāt puruṣa eva gṛhyate prādhānyāt /
analyzed: sa vai eṣa puruṣaḥ nna rasa mayaḥ nna rasa vikāraḥ puruṣa ākṛti bhāvitam hi sarvebhyaḥ ṅgebhyaḥ tejaḥ sambhūtam retaḥ bījam tasmāt yaḥ jāyate tathā puruṣa ākṛtiḥ eva syāt sarva jātiṣu jāyamānānām adarśanāt sarveṣām api anna rasa vikāra tve brahma vaṃśa tve ca a viśiṣṭe kasmāt puruṣaḥ eva gṛhyate prādhānyāt

original: kiṃ punaḥ prādhānyam? karmajñānādhikāraḥ / puruṣa eva hi śaktatvād arthitvād aparyudastatvāc cārthī vidvānsam arthaḥ karmajñānayor adhikriyate — puruṣe tv evāvistarām ātmā sa hi prajñānena sampannatamo vijñātaṃ vadati vijñātaṃ paśyati vedaśvastanaṃ veda lokālokau matryenāmṛtam īkṣati ity evaṃ sampannaḥ /
analyzed: kim punar prādhānyam karma jñāna adhikāraḥ puruṣaḥ eva hi śakta tvāt arthi tvāt a paryudasta tvāt ca arthī vidvān sam arthaḥ karma jñānayoḥ adhikriyate puruṣe tu eva avistarām ātmā sa hi prajñānena sampannatamaḥ vijñātam vadati vijñātam paśyati veda aśvastanam veda loka alokau matryena amṛtam īkṣati iti evam sampannaḥ

original: athetareṣāṃ paśūnāmaśanāpipāse evābhivijñānaṃ (AitĀ 2,3.2-5) ity ādiśrutyantaradarśanāt / sa hi puruṣa iha vidyayā āntaratamaṃ brahma saṅkrāmayitum iṣṭas tasya ca bāhyākāraviśeṣeṣv anātmasvātmabhāvitā buddhir anālambya viśeṣaṃ kaścit sahasā āntaratam apratyagātmaviṣayā nirālambanā ca kartum aśakyeti dṛṣṭaśarīrātmasāmānyakalpanayā
analyzed: atha itareṣām paśūnām aśanā pipāse eva abhivijñānam iti ādi śruti antara darśanāt sa hi puruṣaḥ iha vidyayā āntaratamam brahma saṅkrāmayitum iṣṭaḥ tasya ca bāhya ākāra viśeṣeṣu anātma svātma bhāvitā buddhiḥ an ālambya viśeṣam kaścid sahasā āntaratam a pratyagātma viṣayā nirālambanā ca kartum aśakyā iti dṛṣṭa śarīra ātma sāmānya kalpanayā

original: śākhācandranidarśanavadantaḥ praveśayann āha — tasyedam eva śiraḥ / tasyāsya puruṣasyānnarasamayasyedam eva śiraḥ prasiddham / prāṇamayādiṣv aśirasāṃ śirastvadarśanād ihāpi tatprasaṅgo mā bhūd itīdam eva śira ity ucyate / evaṃ pakṣādiṣu yojanā / ayaṃ dakṣiṇo bāhuḥ pūrvābhimukhasya dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ / ayaṃ savyo bāhuruttaraḥ pakṣaḥ /
analyzed: śākhā candra nidarśana vat antar praveśayan āha tasya idam eva śiraḥ tasya asya puruṣasya anna rasa mayasya idam eva śiraḥ prasiddham prāṇa maya ādiṣu aśirasām śiraḥ tva darśanāt iha api tad prasaṅgaḥ mā bhūt iti idam eva śiraḥ iti ucyate evam pakṣa ādiṣu yojanā ayam dakṣiṇaḥ bāhuḥ pūrva abhimukhasya dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ ayam savyaḥ bāhuḥ uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ

original: ayaṃ madhyamo dehabhāga ātmā aṅgānām madhyaṃ hy eṣām aṅgānām ātmā (AitU 3,5.4) iti śruteḥ idam iti nābher adhastādyadaṅgaṃ tatpucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā / pratitiṣṭhaty anayeti pratiṣṭhā / puccham iva pucchamadholambanasāmānyādyathā goḥ puccham / etat prakṛtyottareṣāṃ prāṇamayādīnāṃ rūpakatvasiddhiḥ, mūṣāniṣiktadrutatāmrapratimāvat /
analyzed: ayam madhyamaḥ dehabhāgaḥ ātmā aṅgānām madhyam hi eṣām aṅgānām ātmā iti śruteḥ idam iti nābheḥ adhastāt yat aṅgam tat puccham pratiṣṭhā pratitiṣṭhati anayā iti pratiṣṭhā puccham iva puccham adhas lambana sāmānyāt yathā goḥ puccham etat prakṛtyā uttareṣām prāṇa maya ādīnām rūpaka tva siddhiḥ mūṣā niṣikta druta tāmra pratimā vat

original: tad apy eṣa śloko bhavati / tat tasminn evārthe brāhmaṇokte 'nnamayātmaprakāśaka eṣa śloko mantro bhavati //
analyzed: tat api eṣa ślokaḥ bhavati tat tasmin eva arthe brāhmaṇa ukte nna maya ātma prakāśakaḥ eṣa ślokaḥ mantraḥ bhavati

original: iti prathamo 'nuvākaḥ // 1 //
analyzed: iti prathamaḥ nuvākaḥ 1

original: annādvai prajāḥ prajāyante / yāḥ kāśca pṛthivīṃśritāḥ / atho annenaiva jīvanti / athainadapi yantyantataḥ / annaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ jyeṣṭham / tasmāt sarvauṣadhamucyate / sarvaṃ vai te 'nnamāpnuvanti / ye 'nnaṃ brahmopāsate / annaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ jyeṣṭham / tasmāt sarvauṣadhamucyate / annādbhūtāni jāyante / jātānyannena vardhante / adyate 'tti ca bhūtāni /
analyzed: annāt vai prajāḥ prajāyante yāḥ kāḥ ca pṛthivīṃśritāḥ atha u annena eva jīvanti atha enat api yanti antatas annam hi bhūtānām jyeṣṭham tasmāt sarva auṣadham ucyate sarvam vai te nnam āpnuvanti ye nnam brahma upāsate annam hi bhūtānām jyeṣṭham tasmāt sarva auṣadham ucyate annāt bhūtāni jāyante jātāni annena vardhante adyate ca bhūtāni

original: tasmādannaṃ taducyata iti / tasmādvā etasmādannarasamayāt / anyo 'ntara ātmā prāṇamayaḥ / tenaiṣa pūrṇaḥ / sa vā eṣa puruṣavidha eva / tasya puruṣavidhatām / anvayaṃ puruṣavidhaḥ / tasya prāṇa eva śiraḥ / vyāno dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ / apāna uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ / ākāśa ātmā / pṛthivī pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā / tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati //
analyzed: tasmāt annam tat ucyate iti tasmāt vai etasmāt anna rasa mayāt anyaḥ ntaraḥ ātmā prāṇa mayaḥ tena eṣa pūrṇaḥ sa vai eṣa puruṣavidhaḥ eva tasya puruṣavidha tām anvayam puruṣavidhaḥ tasya prāṇaḥ eva śiraḥ vyānaḥ dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ apānaḥ uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ ākāśaḥ ātmā pṛthivī puccham pratiṣṭhā tat api eṣa ślokaḥ bhavati

original: iti dvitīyo 'nuvākaḥ // 2 //
analyzed: iti dvitīyaḥ nuvākaḥ 2

original: annādrasādibhāvapariṇataṃāt / vā iti smaraṇārthaḥ / prajāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ prajāyante / yāḥ kāścāviśiṣṭāḥ pṛthivīṃ śritāḥ pṛthivīmāśritāstāḥ sarvā annād eva prajāyante / atho api jātā annenaiva jīvanti prāṇān dhārayanti vardhanta ity arthaḥ / athāpy enad annam apiyanty apigacchanti / apiśabdaḥ pratiśabdārthe / annaṃ prati pralīyanta ity arthaḥ /
analyzed: vā iti smaraṇa arthaḥ prajāḥ sthāvara jaṅgamāḥ prajāyante yāḥ kāḥ ca a viśiṣṭāḥ pṛthivīm śritāḥ pṛthivīm āśritāḥ tāḥ sarvāḥ annāt eva prajāyante atha u api jātāḥ annena eva jīvanti prāṇān dhārayanti vardhante iti arthaḥ atha api enat annam apiyanti apigacchanti apiśabdaḥ pratiśabda arthe annam prati pralīyante iti arthaḥ

original: antato 'nte jīvanalakṣaṇāyā vṛtteḥ parisamāptau / kasmāt / annaṃ hi yasmāt bhūtānāṃ prāṇināṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ prathamajam / annamayādīnāṃ hītareṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ kāraṇam annam / ato 'nnaprabhavā annajīvanā annapralayāś ca sarvāḥ prajāḥ / yasmāc caivaṃ tasmāt sarvauṣadhaṃ sarvaprāṇināṃ dehadāhapraśamanam annam ucyate /
analyzed: antatas nte jīvana lakṣaṇāyāḥ vṛtteḥ parisamāptau kasmāt annam hi yasmāt bhūtānām prāṇinām jyeṣṭham prathama jam anna maya ādīnām hi itareṣām bhūtānām kāraṇam annam atas nna prabhavāḥ anna jīvanāḥ anna pralayāḥ ca sarvāḥ prajāḥ yasmāt ca evam tasmāt sarva auṣadham sarva prāṇinām deha dāha praśamanam annam ucyate

original: annabrahmavidaḥ phalam ucyate / sarvaṃ vai te samastam annajātam āpnuvanti / ke / ye 'nnaṃ brahma yathoktam upāsate / kathaṃ? annajo 'nnātmānnapralayo 'haṃ tasmād annaṃ brahmeti / kutaḥ punaḥ sarvānnaprāptiphalam annātmopāsanam ity ucyate — annaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ jyeṣṭham / bhūtebhyaḥ pūrvam utpannatvāj jyeṣṭhaṃ hi yasmāt tasmāt sarvauṣadham ucyate /
analyzed: anna brahma vidaḥ phalam ucyate sarvam vai te samastam anna jātam āpnuvanti ke ye nnam brahma yathā uktam upāsate katham anna jaḥ nna ātmā anna pralayaḥ ham tasmāt annam brahma iti kutas punar sarva anna prāpti phalam anna ātma upāsanam iti ucyate annam hi bhūtānām jyeṣṭham bhūtebhyaḥ pūrvam utpanna tvāt jyeṣṭham hi yasmāt tasmāt sarva auṣadham ucyate

original: tasmād upapannā sarvānnātmopāsakasya sarvānnaprāptiḥ / annād bhūtāni jāyante, jātāny annena vardhanta ity upasaṃhārārthaṃ punar vacanam / idānīm annanirvacanam ucyate — adyate bhujyate caiva yad bhūtair atti ca bhūtāni svayaṃ, tasmād bhūtair bhujyamānatvād bhūtabhoktṛtvāc cānnaṃ tad ucyate / itiśabdaḥ prathamakośaparisamāptyarthaḥ /
analyzed: tasmāt upapannā sarva anna ātma upāsakasya sarva anna prāptiḥ annāt bhūtāni jāyante jātāni annena vardhante iti upasaṃhāra artham punar vacanam idānīm anna nirvacanam ucyate adyate bhujyate ca eva yat bhūtaiḥ atti ca bhūtāni svayam tasmāt bhūtaiḥ bhujyamāna tvāt bhūta bhoktṛ tvāt ca annam tat ucyate iti śabdaḥ prathama kośa parisamāpti arthaḥ

original: annamayādibhya ānandamayāntebhya ātmabhyo 'bhyantaratamaṃ brahma vidyayā pratyagātmavena didarśayiṣu śāstram avidyākṛtapañcakośāpanayanenānekatuṣakodravavituṣīkaraṇeneva tad antargatataṇḍulān prastauti, tasmād vā etasmād anarasamayād ity ādi /
analyzed: anna maya ādibhyaḥ ānanda maya antebhyaḥ ātmabhyaḥ bhyantaratamam brahma vidyayā pratyagātmavena didarśayiṣu śāstram avidyā kṛta pañcakośa apanayanena aneka tuṣa kodrava vituṣīkaraṇena iva tat antargata taṇḍulān prastauti tasmāt vai etasmāt an arasa mayāt iti ādi

original: tasmād etasmād yathoktād annarasamayāt piṇḍād anyo vyatirikto 'ntaro 'bhyantara ātmā piṇḍavad eva mithyāparikalpitam ātmatvena prāṇamayaḥ, prāṇo vāyus tanmayas tatprāyaḥ / tena prāṇamayena eṣa annarasamaya ātmā pūrṇo vāyuneva dṛtiḥ / sa vā eṣa prāṇamaya ātmā puruṣavidha eva puruṣākāra eva śiraḥpakṣādibhiḥ / kiṃ svata eva, nety āha /
analyzed: tasmāt etasmāt yathā uktāt anna rasa mayāt piṇḍāt anyaḥ vyatiriktaḥ ntaraḥ bhyantaraḥ ātmā piṇḍa vat eva mithyā parikalpitam ātma tvena prāṇa mayaḥ prāṇaḥ vāyuḥ tad mayaḥ tad prāyaḥ tena prāṇa mayena eṣa anna rasa mayaḥ ātmā pūrṇaḥ vāyunā iva dṛtiḥ sa vai eṣa prāṇa mayaḥ ātmā puruṣavidhaḥ eva puruṣa ākāraḥ eva śiraḥ pakṣa ādibhiḥ kim svatas eva na iti āha

original: prasiddhaṃ tāvad annarasamayasyātmanaḥ puruṣavidhatvam / tasyānnarasamayasya puruṣavidhatāṃ puruṣākāratām / anvayaṃ prāṇamayaḥ puruṣavidho mūṣāniṣiktapratimāvanna svata eva / evaṃ pūrvasya pūrvasya puruṣavidhatā, tām anūttarottaraḥ puruṣavidho bhavati, pūrvaḥ pūrvaś cottarottareṇa pūrṇaḥ /
analyzed: prasiddham tāvat anna rasa mayasya ātmanaḥ puruṣavidha tvam tasya anna rasa mayasya puruṣavidha tām puruṣa ākāra tām anvayam prāṇa mayaḥ puruṣavidhaḥ mūṣā niṣikta pratimāvat na svatas eva evam pūrvasya pūrvasya puruṣavidha tā tām anūttara uttaraḥ puruṣavidhaḥ bhavati pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ ca uttarottareṇa pūrṇaḥ

original: kathaṃ punaḥ puruṣavidhatāsyety ucyate — tasya prāṇamayasya prāṇa eva śiraḥ prāṇamayasya vāyuvikārasya prāṇo mukhanāsikāniḥsaraṇo vṛttiviśeṣaḥ śira eva parikalpyate, vacanāt / sarvatra vacanād eva pakṣādikalpanā / vyāno vyānavṛttir dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ / apāna uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ /
analyzed: katham punar puruṣavidha tā asya iti ucyate tasya prāṇa mayasya prāṇaḥ eva śiraḥ prāṇa mayasya vāyu vikārasya prāṇaḥ mukha nāsikā niḥsaraṇaḥ vṛtti viśeṣaḥ śiraḥ eva parikalpyate vacanāt sarvatra vacanāt eva pakṣa ādi kalpanā vyānaḥ vyāna vṛttiḥ dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ apānaḥ uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ

original: ākāśa ātmā, yā ākāśastho vṛttiviśeṣaḥ samānākhyaḥ sa ātmeva ātmā prāṇavṛttyadhikārād madhyasthatvāditarāḥ paryantā vṛttīr apekṣya ātmā / madhyaṃ hy eṣām aṅgānām ātmā (AitU 3,5.4) iti śrutiprasiddha madhyasthasyātmatvam / pṛthivī pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā / pṛthivīti pṛthivīdevatā ādhyātmikasya prāṇasya dhārayitrī sthitihetutvāt /
analyzed: ākāśaḥ ātmā yā ākāśa sthaḥ vṛtti viśeṣaḥ samāna ākhyaḥ saḥ ātmā iva ātmā prāṇa vṛtti adhikārāt madhya stha tvāt itarāḥ paryantāḥ vṛttīḥ apekṣya ātmā madhyam hi eṣām aṅgānām ātmā iti śruti prasiddha madhya sthasya ātma tvam pṛthivī puccham pratiṣṭhā pṛthivī iti pṛthivī devatā ādhyātmikasya prāṇasya dhārayitrī sthiti hetu tvāt

original: saiṣā puruṣasyāpānam avaṣṭabhya (PraśU 3,8) iti hi śrutyantaram / anyathodānavṛttyordhvagamanaṃ gurutvāt patanaṃ vā syāc charīrasya / tasmāt pṛthivī devatā pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā prāṇamayasyātmanaḥ / tat tasminn evārthe prāṇamayātmaviṣaya eṣa śloko bhavati //
analyzed: sā eṣā puruṣasya apānam avaṣṭabhya iti hi śruti antaram anyathā udāna vṛttyā ūrdhva gamanam guru tvāt patanam vā syāt śarīrasya tasmāt pṛthivī devatā puccham pratiṣṭhā prāṇa mayasya ātmanaḥ tat tasmin eva arthe prāṇa maya ātma viṣayaḥ eṣa ślokaḥ bhavati

original: prāṇaṃ devā anu prāṇanti / manuṣyāḥ paśavaśca ye / prāṇo hi bhūtānāmāyuḥ / tasmāt sarvāyuṣamucyate / sarvameva ta āyuryanti / ye prāṇaṃ brahmopāsate / prāṇo hi bhūtānāmāyuḥ / tasmāt sarvāyuṣamucyata iti / tasyaiṣa eva śārīra ātmā / yaḥ pūrvasya / tasmādvā etasmāt prāṇamayāt / anyo 'ntara ātmā manomayaḥ / tenaiṣa pūrṇaḥ /
analyzed: prāṇam devāḥ anu prāṇanti manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ ca ye prāṇaḥ hi bhūtānām āyuḥ tasmāt sarva āyuṣam ucyate sarvam eva te āyuḥ yanti ye prāṇam brahma upāsate prāṇaḥ hi bhūtānām āyuḥ tasmāt sarva āyuṣam ucyate iti tasya eṣaḥ eva śārīraḥ ātmā yaḥ pūrvasya tasmāt vai etasmāt prāṇa mayāt anyaḥ ntaraḥ ātmā manaḥ mayaḥ tena eṣa pūrṇaḥ

original: sa vā eṣa puruṣavidha eva / tasya puruṣavidhatām / anvayaṃ puruṣavidhaḥ / tasya yajureva śiraḥ / ṛgdakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ / sāmottaraḥ pakṣaḥ / ādeśa ātmā / atharvāṅgirasaḥ pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā / tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati //
analyzed: sa vai eṣa puruṣavidhaḥ eva tasya puruṣavidha tām anvayam puruṣavidhaḥ tasya yajuḥ eva śiraḥ ṛc dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ sāma uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ ādeśaḥ ātmā atharva aṅgirasaḥ puccham pratiṣṭhā tat api eṣa ślokaḥ bhavati

original: iti tṛtīyo 'nuvākaḥ // 3 //
analyzed: iti tṛtīyaḥ nuvākaḥ 3

original: prāṇaṃ devā anu prāṇanti / devā agnyādayaḥ prāṇaṃ vāyvātmānaṃ prāṇanaśaktimantamanu tadātmabhūtāḥ santaḥ prāṇanti prāṇanakarma kurvanti, prāṇanakriyayā kriyāvanto bhavanti / adhyātmādhikārād devā indriyāṇi prāṇam anu prāṇanti mukhyaprāṇam anu ceṣṭanta iti vā / tathā manuṣyāḥ paśavaś ca ye te prāṇanakarmaṇaiva ceṣṭāvanto bhavanti /
analyzed: prāṇam devāḥ anu prāṇanti devāḥ agni ādayaḥ prāṇam vāyu ātmānam prāṇana śaktimantam anu tad ātma bhūtāḥ santaḥ prāṇanti prāṇana karma kurvanti prāṇana kriyayā kriyāvantaḥ bhavanti adhyātma adhikārāt devāḥ indriyāṇi prāṇam anu prāṇanti mukhya prāṇam anu ceṣṭante iti vā tathā manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ ca ye te prāṇana karmaṇā eva ceṣṭāvantaḥ bhavanti

original: ataś ca nānnamayenaiva paricchinnena ātmanā ātmavantaḥ prāṇinaḥ / kiṃ tarhi? tadantargatena prāṇamayenāpi sādhāraṇenaiva sarvapiṇḍavyāpinā ātmavantī manuṣyādayaḥ / evaṃ manomayādibhiḥ pūrvapūrvavyāpibhir uttarottaraiḥ sūkṣmair ānandamayāntair ākāśādibhūtārabdhair avidyākṛtair ātmavantaḥ sarve prāṇinaḥ /
analyzed: atas ca na anna mayena eva paricchinnena ātmanā ātmavantaḥ prāṇinaḥ kim tarhi tad antargatena prāṇa mayena api sādhāraṇena eva sarva piṇḍa vyāpinā manuṣya ādayaḥ evam manaḥ maya ādibhiḥ pūrva pūrva vyāpibhiḥ uttara uttaraiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ ānanda maya antaiḥ ākāśa ādi bhūta ārabdhaiḥ avidyā kṛtaiḥ ātmavantaḥ sarve prāṇinaḥ

original: tadvijñānaṃ ca vivakṣitaṃ, prakṛtaṃ ca tat / brahmasvarūpāvagamāya cākāśādyannamayāntaṃ kāryaṃ pradarśitaṃ, brahmāvagamaś cārabdhaḥ / tatrānnamayād ātmano 'nyo 'ntara ātmā prāṇamayaḥ, tadantarmanomayo vijñānamaya iti vijñānaguhāyāṃ praveśitaḥ / tatra cānandamayo viśiṣṭa ātmā pradarśitaḥ /

original: ataḥ paramānandamayaliṅgādhigamadvāreṇānandavivṛddhyavasāna ātmā / brahma pucchaṃ pratiṣṭhā sarvavikalpāspado nirvikalpo 'syām eva guhāyām adhigantavya iti tatpraveśaḥ prakalpyate / na hy anyatropalabhyate brahma nirviśeṣatvāt / viśeṣasambandho hy upalabdhihetur dṛṣṭaḥ / yathā rāhoś candrārkaviśeṣasambandhaḥ /
analyzed: atas paramānanda maya liṅga adhigama dvāreṇa ānanda vivṛddhi avasānaḥ ātmā brahma puccham pratiṣṭhā sarva vikalpa āspadaḥ syām eva guhāyām adhigantavyaḥ iti tad praveśaḥ prakalpyate na hi anyatra upalabhyate brahma nirviśeṣa tvāt viśeṣa sambandhaḥ hi upalabdhi hetuḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā rāhoḥ candra arka viśeṣa sambandhaḥ

original: evam antaḥkaraṇaguhātmasambandho brahmaṇa upalabdhihetuḥ / sannikarṣād avabhāsātmakatvāc cāntaḥkaraṇasya / yathā cālokaviśiṣṭā ghaṭādyupalabdhir evaṃ buddhipratyayālokaviśiṣṭā ātmopalabdhiḥ syāta / tasmād upalabdhihetau guhāyāṃ nihitam iti prakṛtam eva / tadbhṛttisthānīye tv iha punas tatsṛṣṭvā tad evānuprāviśat (TaittU 2,6.1) ity ucyate /
analyzed: evam antaḥkaraṇa guhā ātma sambandhaḥ brahmaṇaḥ upalabdhi hetuḥ sannikarṣāt avabhāsa ātmaka tvāt ca antaḥkaraṇasya yathā ca āloka viśiṣṭā ghaṭa ādi upalabdhiḥ evam buddhi pratyaya āloka viśiṣṭā ātma upalabdhiḥ syāta tasmāt upalabdhi hetau guhāyām nihitam iti prakṛtam eva tad bhṛtti sthānīye tu iha punar tat sṛṣṭvā tat eva anuprāviśat TaittU iti ucyate

original: tad evedam ākāśādikāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ sṛṣṭvā tadanupraviṣṭam ivāntarmuhāyāṃ buddhau draṣṭṛ śrotṛ mantṛ vijñātr ity evaṃ viśeṣavad upalabhyate / sa eva tasya praveśaḥ / tasmād astitatkāraṇaṃ brahma / ato 'stitvād astīty evopalabdhavyaṃ tat / tatkāryam anupraviśya, kiṃ, sac ca mūrtaṃ tyāc cāmūrtam abhavat /
analyzed: tat eva idam ākāśa ādi kāraṇam kāryam sṛṣṭvā tat anupraviṣṭam iva antarmuhāyām buddhau draṣṭṛ śrotṛ mantṛ vijñātṛ iti evam viśeṣa vat upalabhyate saḥ eva tasya praveśaḥ tasmāt asti tad kāraṇam brahma atas stitvāt asti iti eva upalabdhavyam tat tat kāryam anupraviśya kim sat ca mūrtam ca amūrtam abhavat

original: mūrtāmūrte hy āvyākṛtanāmarūpa ātmasthe antargatenātmanā vyākriyete / vyākṛte ca mūrtāmūrtaśabdavācye te ātmanā tv apravibhaktadeśakāla iti kṛtvā ātmā te abhavad ity ucyate / kiñca niruktaṃ cāniruktaṃ ca, niruktaṃ nāma niṣkṛṣya samānāsamānajātīyebhyo deśakālaviśiṣṭatayedaṃ tad ity uktaṃ, aniruktataṃ tadviparītam /
analyzed: mūrta amūrte hi āvyākṛta nāma rūpe ātma sthe antargatena ātmanā vyākriyete vyākṛte ca mūrta amūrta śabda vācye te ātmanā tu a pravibhakta deśa kāle iti kṛtvā ātmā te abhavat iti ucyate kiñca niruktam ca aniruktam ca niruktam nāma niṣkṛṣya samāna asamāna jātīyebhyaḥ deśa kāla viśiṣṭa tayā idam tat iti uktam tad viparītam

original: niruktānirukta api mūrtāmūrtayor eva viśeṣaṇaṃ / yathā sac ca tyac ca pratyakṣaparokṣe, tathā nilayanaṃ cānilayanaṃ ca / nilayanaṃ nīḍam āśrayo mūrtasyaiva dharmaḥ / anilayanaṃ tadviparītam amūrtasyaiva dharmaḥ / tyad aniruktānilayanānyamūrtadharmatve 'pi vyākṛtaviṣayāṇy eva / sargottarakālabhāvaśravaṇāt /
analyzed: nirukta aniruktaḥ api mūrta amūrtayoḥ eva viśeṣaṇam yathā sat ca tyad ca pratyakṣa parokṣe tathā nilayanam ca anilayanam ca nilayanam nīḍam āśrayaḥ mūrtasya eva dharmaḥ anilayanam tad viparītam amūrtasya eva dharmaḥ tyad anirukta anilayanāni amūrta dharma tve vyākṛta viṣayāṇi eva sarga uttara kāla bhāva śravaṇāt

original: tyad iti prāṇādyaniruktaṃ tad evānilayanaṃ ca / ato viśeṣaṇāny amūrtasya vyākṛtaviṣayāṇy evaitāni / vijñānaṃ cetanam avijñānaṃ tadrahitam acetana pāṣāṇādi / satyaṃ ca vyavahāraviṣayam adhikārān na paramārthasatyam / ekam eva hi paramārthasatyaṃ brahma / iha punar vyavahāraviṣayam āpekṣikaṃ satyaṃ, mṛgatṛṣṇikādyanṛtāpekṣayodakādi satyam ucyate /
analyzed: iti prāṇa ādi aniruktam tat eva anilayanam ca atas viśeṣaṇāni amūrtasya vyākṛta viṣayāṇi eva etāni vijñānam cetanam avijñānam tad rahitam acetana pāṣāṇa ādi satyam ca vyavahāra viṣayam adhikārāt na paramārtha satyam ekam eva hi paramārtha satyam brahma iha punar vyavahāra viṣayam āpekṣikam satyam mṛgatṛṣṇika ādi anṛta apekṣayā udaka ādi satyam ucyate

original: anṛtaṃ ca tadviparītam / kiṃ punar etat sarvam abhavat / satyaṃ paramārthasatyaṃ, kiṃ punas tat? brahma / satyaṃ jñānam anantaṃ brahmeti prakṛtatvāt /
analyzed: anṛtam ca tad viparītam kim punar etat sarvam abhavat satyam paramārtha satyam kim punar tat brahma satyam jñānam anantam brahma iti prakṛta tvāt

original: yasmāt sattyadādikaṃ mūrtāmūrtadharmajātaṃ yatkiñcedaṃ sarvam aviśiṣṭaṃ vikārajātam ekam eva sacchabdavācyaṃ brahmābhavattadvyatirekeṇābhāvān nāmarūpavikārasya, tasmāt tadbrahma satyam ity ācakṣate brahmavidaḥ / asti nāstīty anupraśnaḥ prakṛtaḥ, tasya prativacanaviṣaya etad uktaṃ — ātmākāmayata bahu syām iti /
analyzed: yasmāt mūrta amūrta dharma jātam yat kiñca idam sarvam aviśiṣṭam vikāra jātam ekam eva sat śabda vācyam brahma abhavat tad vyatirekeṇa abhāvān nāma rūpa vikārasya tasmāt tat brahma satyam iti ācakṣate brahma vidaḥ asti na asti iti anupraśnaḥ prakṛtaḥ tasya prativacana viṣayaḥ etat uktam ātmā akāmayata bahu syām iti

original: sa yathākāmaṃ cākāśādikāryaṃ sattyadādilakṣaṇaṃ sṛṣṭvā tad anupraviśya paśyañ śṛṇvan manvāno vijānan bahv abhavat / tasmāt tad evedam ākāśādikāraṇaṃ kāryasthaṃ parame vyoman hṛdayaguhāyāṃ nihitaṃ tatpratyayāvabhāsaviśeṣeṇopalabhyamānam astīty evaṃ vijānīyādityuktaṃ bhavati / tad etasminn arthe brāhmaṇokta eṣa śloko mantro bhavati /
analyzed: sa yathākāmam ca ākāśa ādi kāryam satti ad ādi lakṣaṇam sṛṣṭvā tat anupraviśya paśyan śṛṇvan manvānaḥ vijānan bahu abhavat tasmāt tat eva idam ākāśa ādi kāraṇam kārya stham parame vyoman hṛdaya guhāyām nihitam tad pratyaya avabhāsa viśeṣeṇa upalabhyamānam asti iti evam vijānīyāt iti uktam bhavati tat etasmin arthe brāhmaṇa uktaḥ eṣa ślokaḥ mantraḥ bhavati

original: yathā pūrveṣv annamayādyātmaprakāśakāḥ pañcasv api, evaṃ sarvāntaram ātmāstitvaprakāśako 'pi mantraḥ kāryadvāreṇa bhavati //
analyzed: yathā pūrveṣu anna maya ādi ātma prakāśakāḥ pañcasu api evam sarva antaram ātma astitva prakāśakaḥ mantraḥ kārya dvāreṇa bhavati

original: // iti ṣaṣṭho 'nuvākaḥ //
analyzed: iti ṣaṣṭhaḥ nuvākaḥ

original: asadvā idamagra āsīt / tato vai sadajāyata / tadātmānaṃ svayamakuruta / tasmāttatsukṛtamucyata iti / yadvai tat sukṛtam / raso vai saḥ / rasaṃ hyevāyaṃ labdhvānandī bhavati / ko hyevānyātkaḥ prāṇyāt / yadeṣa ākāśa ānando na syāt / eṣa hyevānandayāti / yadā hyevaiṣa etasminnadṛśye 'nātmye 'nirukte 'nilayane 'bhayaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vindate /
analyzed: asat vai idam agre āsīt tatas vai sat ajāyata tat ātmānam svayam akuruta tasmāt tat su kṛtam ucyate iti yat vai tat su kṛtam rasaḥ vai saḥ rasam hi eva ayam labdhvā ānandī bhavati kaḥ hi eva anyāt kaḥ prāṇyāt yat eṣaḥ ākāśaḥ ānandaḥ na syāt eṣa hi eva ānandayāti yadā hi eva eṣa etasmin adṛśye nātmye nirukte nilayane bhayam pratiṣṭhām vindate

original: atha so 'bhayaṃ gato bhavati / yadā hyevaiṣa etasminnudaramantaraṃ kurute / atha tasya bhayaṃ bhavati / tatveva bhayaṃ viduṣo 'manvānasya / tadapyeṣa śloko bhavati //
analyzed: atha saḥ bhayam gataḥ bhavati yadā hi eva eṣa etasmin udaram antaram kurute atha tasya bhayam bhavati bhayam viduṣaḥ manvānasya tat api eṣa ślokaḥ bhavati

original: iti saptamo 'nuvākaḥ // 7 //
analyzed: iti saptamaḥ nuvākaḥ 7

original: asad vā idam agra āsīt / asad iti vyākṛtanāmarūpaviśeṣaviparītarūpam avikṛtaṃ brahmocyate / na punar atyantam evāsat / na hy asataḥ sajjanmāsti / idam iti nāmarūpaviśeṣavadvyākṛtaṃ jagad agre pūrvaṃ prāgutpatter brahmaivāsacchabdavācyam āsīt / tato 'sato vai satpravibhaktanāmarūpaviśeṣamajāyatotpannam /
analyzed: asat vai idam agre āsīt asat iti vyākṛta nāma rūpa viśeṣa viparīta rūpam avikṛtam brahma ucyate na punar atyantam eva asat na hi asataḥ sat janma asti idam iti nāma rūpa viśeṣa vat vyākṛtam jagat agre pūrvam prāk utpatteḥ brahma eva asat śabda vācyam āsīt tatas u sataḥ vai sat pravibhakta nāma rūpa viśeṣam ajāyata utpannam

original: kiṃ tataḥ pravibhaktaṃ kāryam iti pitur iva putraḥ? nety āha / tadasacchabdavācyaṃ svayam evātmānam evākuruta kṛtavat / yasmād evaṃ tasmāt tad brahmaiva sukṛtaṃ svayaṃ kartr ucyate / svayaṃ kartṛ brahmeti prasiddhaṃ loke sarvakāraṇatvāt / yasmād vā svayam akarot sarvaṃ sarvātmanā, tasmāt puṇyarūpeṇāpi tad eva brahma kāraṇaṃ sukṛtam ucyate /
analyzed: kim tatas pravibhaktam kāryam iti pituḥ iva putraḥ na iti āha tat asat śabda vācyam svayam eva ātmānam eva akuruta kṛta vat yasmāt evam tasmāt tat brahma eva su kṛtam svayam kartā ucyate svayam kartṛ brahma iti prasiddham loke sarva kāraṇa tvāt yasmāt vā svayam akarot sarvam sarva ātmanā tasmāt puṇya rūpeṇa api tat eva brahma kāraṇam su kṛtam ucyate

original: sarvathāpi tu phalasambandhādikāraṇaṃ sukṛtaśabdavācyaṃ prasiddhaṃ loke / yadi puṇyaṃ yadi vānyat sā prasiddhiḥ nitye cetanavatkāraṇe saty upapadyate, tasmād asti tadbrahma, sukṛtaprasiddheḥ / itaś cāsti / kutaḥ rasatvāt / kuto rasatvaprasiddhir brahmaṇo ity ata āha — yad vai tatsukṛtaṃ raso vai saḥ /
analyzed: sarvathā api tu phala sambandha ādi kāraṇam sukṛta śabda vācyam prasiddham loke yadi puṇyam yadi vā anyat sā prasiddhiḥ nitye cetanavat kāraṇe satī upapadyate tasmāt asti tat brahma sukṛta prasiddheḥ itas ca asti kutas rasa tvāt kutas rasa tva prasiddhiḥ brahmaṇaḥ iti atas āha yat vai tat sukṛtam rasaḥ vai saḥ

original: raso nāma tṛptihetur ānandakaro madhurāmlādiḥ prasiddho loke / rasam eva hy ayaṃ labdhvā prāpya ānandī sukhī bhavati / nāsata ānandahetutvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ loke / bāhyānandasādhanarahitā apy anīhā nireṣaṇā brāhmaṇā bāhyarasalābhād iva sānandā dṛśyante vidvāṃsaḥ, nūnaṃ brahmaiva rasas teṣām / tasmād asti tat teṣām ānandakāraṇaṃ rasavadbrahma / itaścāti /
analyzed: rasaḥ nāma tṛpti hetuḥ ānanda karaḥ madhura amla ādiḥ prasiddhaḥ loke rasam eva hi ayam labdhvā prāpya ānandī sukhī bhavati na asataḥ ānanda hetu tvam dṛṣṭam loke bāhya ānanda sādhana rahitāḥ api anīhāḥ nireṣaṇāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ bāhya rasa lābhāt iva sa ānandāḥ dṛśyante vidvāṃsaḥ nūnam brahma eva rasaḥ teṣām tasmāt asti tat teṣām ānanda kāraṇam rasavat brahma itas ca ati ananda anubhūtiḥ sarva ananda anubhūtiḥ anubhūtiḥ anub

original: kutaḥ? prāṇanādikriyādarśanāt / ayam api hi piṇḍo jīvataḥ prāṇena prāṇityapānenāpān iti / evaṃ vāyavīyā aindriyakāś ca ceṣṭāḥ saṃhataiḥ kāryakāraṇair nirvartyamanā dṛśyante / tac caikārthavṛttitvena saṃhananaṃ nāntareṇa cetanam asaṃhataṃ sambhavati / anyatrādarśanāt /
analyzed: kutas prāṇana ādi kriyā darśanāt ayam api hi piṇḍaḥ jīvataḥ prāṇena prāṇiti apānena apān iti evam vāyavīyāḥ aindriyakāḥ ca ceṣṭāḥ saṃhataiḥ kārya kāraṇaiḥ nirvartya manāḥ dṛśyante tat ca eka artha vṛtti tvena saṃhananam na antareṇa cetanam asaṃhatam sambhavati anyatra adarśanāt

original: tad āha yad yadi eṣa ākāśe parame vyomni guhāyāṃ nihita ānando na syān na bhavet ko hy eva loke 'nyād apānaceṣṭāṃ kuryād ity arthaḥ / kaḥ prāṇyāt prāṇanaṃ vā kuryāt / tasmād asti tad brahma / yad arthāḥ kāraṇapraṇanādiceṣṭāḥ tat kṛta eva cānando lokasya / kutaḥ / eṣa hy eva para ātmā ānandayātyānandayati sukhayati lokaṃ dharmānurūpam /
analyzed: tat āha yat yadi eṣaḥ ākāśe parame vyomni guhāyām nihitaḥ ānandaḥ na syāt na bhavet kaḥ hi eva loke apāna ceṣṭām kuryāt iti arthaḥ kaḥ prāṇyāt prāṇanam vā kuryāt tasmāt asti tat brahma yat arthāḥ kāraṇa praṇana ādi ceṣṭāḥ tat kṛtaḥ eva ca ānandaḥ lokasya kutas eṣa hi eva paraḥ ātmā ānandayāti ānandayati sukhayati lokam dharma anurūpam

original: sa evātmānandarūpo 'vidyayā paricchinno vibhāvyate prāṇibhir ity arthaḥ / bhayābhayahetutvād vidvadaviduṣor asti tad brahma / sadvastvāśrayaṇena hy abhayaṃ bhavati / nāsadvastvāśrayaṇena bhayanivṛttir upapadyate /
analyzed: saḥ eva ātmā ānanda rūpaḥ vidyayā paricchinnaḥ vibhāvyate prāṇibhiḥ iti arthaḥ bhaya abhaya hetu tvāt vidvat aviduṣoḥ asti tat brahma sat vastu āśrayaṇena hi abhayam bhavati na asat vastu āśrayaṇena bhaya nivṛttiḥ upapadyate

original: katham abhayahetutvabhity ucyate — yadā hy eva yasmād eṣa sādhaka etasmin brahmaṇi, kiṃviśiṣṭe 'dṛśye, dṛśyaṃ nāma draṣṭavyaṃ vikāro darśanārthatvād vikārasya / na dṛśyam adṛśyavikāra ity arthaḥ / etasminn adṛśye 'vikāre 'viṣayabhūte 'nātmye 'śarīre yasmād adṛśyaṃ tasmād anātmyaṃ yasmād anātmyaṃ tasmād aniruktam / viśeṣo hi nirucyate /
analyzed: katham ucyate yadā hi eva yasmāt eṣa sādhakaḥ etasmin brahmaṇi kiṃviśiṣṭe dṛśye dṛśyam nāma draṣṭavyam vikāraḥ darśana artha tvāt vikārasya na dṛśyam adṛśya vikāraḥ iti arthaḥ etasmin adṛśye vikāre viṣaya bhūte nātmye śarīre yasmāt adṛśyam tasmāt anātmyam yasmāt anātmyam tasmāt aniruktam viśeṣaḥ hi nirucyate

original: viśeṣaś ca vikāraḥ / avikāraṃ ca brahma / sarvavikārahetutvāt / tasmād aniruktam / yata evaṃ tasmād anilayanaṃ nilayanaṃ nīḍa āśrayo na nilayanam anilayanam anādhāraṃ tasminn etasminn adṛśye 'nātmye 'nirukte 'nilayane (TaittU 2,7.1) sarvakāryadharmavilakṣaṇe brahmaṇīti vākyārthaḥ / abhayam iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam /
analyzed: viśeṣaḥ ca vikāraḥ avikāram ca brahma sarva vikāra hetu tvāt tasmāt aniruktam yatas evam tasmāt anilayanam nilayanam nīḍaḥ āśrayaḥ na nilayanam anilayanam anādhāram tasmin etasmin adṛśye nātmye nirukte nilayane sarva kārya dharma vilakṣaṇe brahmaṇi iti vākya arthaḥ abhayam iti kriyā viśeṣaṇam

original: abhayām iti vā liṅgāntaraṃ pariṇamyate / pratiṣṭhāṃ sthitim ātmabhāvaṃ vindate labhate / atha tadā sa tasmin yānātvasya bhayahetor avidyākṛtasyā darśanād abhayaṃ gato bhavati / svarūpapratiṣṭho hy asau yadā bhavati, tadā nānyatpaśyati nānyacchṛṇoti nānyadvijānāti / anyasya hy anyato bhayaṃ bhavati, na ātmana evātmano bhayaṃ yuktam /
analyzed: abhayām iti vā liṅga antaram pariṇamyate pratiṣṭhām sthitim ātma bhāvam vindate labhate atha tadā sa tasmin yānātvasya bhaya hetoḥ avidyā kṛtasyāḥ darśanāt abhayam gataḥ bhavati sva rūpa pratiṣṭhaḥ hi asau yadā bhavati tadā na anyat paśyati na anyat śṛṇoti na anyat vijānāti anyasya hi anyatas bhayam bhavati na ātmanaḥ eva ātmanaḥ bhayam yuktam

original: tasmād ātmaivātmano 'bhayakāraṇam / sarvato hi nirbhayā brāhmaṇā dṛśyante satsu bhayahetuṣu / taccāyuktam asati bhayatrāṇe brahmaṇi / tasmāt teṣām abhayadarśanād asti tadabhayakāraṇaṃ brahmeti / kadāsāv abhayaṃ gato bhavati sādhakaḥ? yadā nānyat paśyaty ātmani cāntaraṃ bhedaṃ na kurute, tadābhayaṃ gato bhavatīty abhiprāyaḥ /
analyzed: tasmāt ātmā eva ātmanaḥ bhaya kāraṇam sarvatas hi nirbhayāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ dṛśyante satsu bhaya hetuṣu tat ca ayuktam asati bhaya trāṇe brahmaṇi tasmāt teṣām abhaya darśanāt asti tat abhaya kāraṇam brahma iti kadā asau abhayam gataḥ bhavati sādhakaḥ yadā na anyat paśyati ātmani ca antaram bhedam na kurute tadā abhayam gataḥ bhavati iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: yadā punar avidyāvasthāyāṃ hi yasmād eṣo 'vidyāvānavidyayā pratyupasthāpita vastu taimirikadvitīyacandravat paśyaty ātmani caitasmin brahmaṇi, udapi, aramalpamaṇy antaraṃ chidraṃ bhedadarśanaṃ kurute / bhedadarśanam eva hy antaraṇakaraṇam alpam api bhedaṃ paśyatīty arthaḥ / atha tasmād bhedadarśanād dhetor asya bhedadarśina ātmano bhayaṃ bhavati /
analyzed: yadā punar avidyā avasthāyām hi yasmāt eṣaḥ vidyāvān avidyayā vastu taimirika dvitīya candra vat paśyati ātmani ca etasmin brahmaṇi antaram chidram bheda darśanam kurute bheda darśanam eva hi antaraṇa karaṇam alpam api bhedam paśyati iti arthaḥ atha tasmāt bheda darśanāt hetoḥ asya bheda darśinaḥ ātmanaḥ bhayam bhavati

original: tasmād ātmevātmano bhayakāraṇam aviduṣaḥ / tad etad āha — tadbrahma tv eva bhayaṃ bhedadarśino 'viduṣa īśvaro 'nyo matto 'ham anyaḥ saṃsārīty evaṃviduṣo bhedadṛṣṭam īśvarākhyaṃ tad eva brahmālpam apy antaraṃ kurvato bhayaṃ bhavaty ekatvenāmanvānasya / tasmād vidvān apy avidvān evāsau yo 'yam ekam abhinnam ātmatattvaṃ na paśyati /
analyzed: tasmāt ātmā iva ātmanaḥ bhaya kāraṇam a viduṣaḥ tat etat āha tat brahma tu eva bhayam bheda darśinaḥ viduṣaḥ īśvaraḥ nyaḥ mattaḥ ham anyaḥ saṃsārī iti evaṃviduṣaḥ bheda dṛṣṭam īśvara ākhyam tat eva brahma alpam api antaram kurvataḥ bhayam bhavati ekatvena a manvānasya tasmāt vidvān api a vidvān eva asau yaḥ yam ekam abhinnam ātma tattvam na paśyati

original: ucchedahetudarśanād dhy ucchedyābhimatasya bhayaṃ bhavati / anucchedyo hy ucchedahetuḥ / tatrāsty ucchedahetāv anucchedye taddarśanakārye bhayaṃ yuktam / sarvaṃ ca jagadbhayavat dṛśyate / tasmāj jagato bhavadarśanād gamyate nūnaṃ tad asti bhayakāraṇam ucchedahetur anucchedyātmaka yato jagadbibhetīti / tad etasminn apy artha eṣa śloko bhavati //
analyzed: uccheda hetu darśanāt dhi ucchedya abhimatasya bhayam bhavati an ucchedyaḥ hi uccheda hetuḥ tatra asti uccheda hetau an ucchedye tad darśana kārye bhayam yuktam sarvam ca jagat bhayavat dṛśyate tasmāt jagataḥ bhava darśanāt gamyate nūnam tat asti bhaya kāraṇam uccheda hetuḥ yatas jagat bibheti iti tat etasmin api arthe eṣa ślokaḥ bhavati

original: iti saptamo 'nuvākaḥ //
analyzed: iti saptamaḥ nuvākaḥ

original: bhīṣāsmādvātaḥ pavate / bhīṣodeti sūryaḥ / bhīṣāsmādagniścendraśca / mṛtyurdhāvati pañcama iti / saiṣānandasya mīmāṃsā bhavati / yuvā syātsādhuyuvādhyāyakaḥ / āśiṣṭho dṛḍhiṣṭho baliṣṭhaḥ / tasyeyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā vittasya pūrṇā syāt / sa eko mānuṣa ānandaḥ / te ye śataṃ mānuṣā ānandāḥ //
analyzed: bhīṣā asmāt vātaḥ pavate bhīṣā udeti sūryaḥ bhīṣā asmāt agniḥ ca indraḥ ca mṛtyuḥ dhāvati pañcamaḥ iti sā eṣā ānandasya mīmāṃsā bhavati yuvā syāt sādhu yuvā adhyāyakaḥ āśiṣṭhaḥ dṛḍhiṣṭhaḥ baliṣṭhaḥ tasya iyam pṛthivī sarvā vittasya pūrṇā syāt saḥ ekaḥ mānuṣaḥ ānandaḥ te ye śatam mānuṣāḥ ānandāḥ

original: sa eko manuṣyagandharvāṇāmānandaḥ / śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya / te ye śataṃ manuṣyagandharvāṇāmānandāḥ / sa eko devagandharvāṇāmānandaḥ / śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya / te ye śataṃ devagandharvāṇāmānandāḥ / sa ekaḥ pitṝṇāṃ ciralokalokānāmānandaḥ / śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya / te ye śataṃ pitṝṇāṃ ciralokalokānāmānandāḥ /
analyzed: saḥ ekaḥ manuṣya gandharvāṇām ānandaḥ śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam manuṣya gandharvāṇām ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ devagandharvāṇām ānandaḥ śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam devagandharvāṇām ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ pitṝṇām ciralokalokānām ānandaḥ śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam pitṝṇām ciralokalokānām ānandāḥ

original: sa eka ājānajānāṃ devānāmānandaḥ //
analyzed: saḥ ekaḥ ājāna jānām devānām ānandaḥ

original: śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya / te ye śatam ājānajānāṃ devānāmānandāḥ / sa ekaḥ karmadevānāṃ devānāmānandaḥ / ye karmaṇā devānapiyanti / śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya / te ye śataṃ karmadevānāṃ devānāmānandāḥ / sa eko devānāmānandaḥ / śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya / te ye śataṃ devānāmānandāḥ / sa eka indrasyānandaḥ //
analyzed: śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam ājāna jānām devānām ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ karma devānām devānām ānandaḥ ye karmaṇā devān apiyanti śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam karma devānām devānām ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ devānām ānandaḥ śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam karma devānām devānām ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ devānām ānandaḥ śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam devānām ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ indrasya ānandaḥ

original: śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya / te ye śatamindrasyānandāḥ / sa eko bṛhaspaterānandaḥ / śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya / te ye śataṃ bṛhaspaterānandāḥ / sa ekaḥ prajāpaterānandaḥ / śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya / te ye śataṃ prajāpaterānandāḥ / sa eko brahmaṇa ānandaḥ / śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya //
analyzed: śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam indrasya ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ bṛhaspateḥ ānandaḥ śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam bṛhaspateḥ ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ prajāpateḥ ānandaḥ śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya te ye śatam prajāpateḥ ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ brahmaṇaḥ ānandaḥ śrotriyasya ca a kāma hatasya

original: bhīṣā bhayenāsmād vātaḥ pavate / bhīṣodeti sūryaḥ / bhīṣāsmād agniś cendraś ca mṛtyur dhāvati paścama iti / vātādayo hi mahārhāḥ svayam īśvarāḥ santaḥ pavanādikāryeṣv āyāsabahuleṣu niyatāḥ pravartante / tadyuktaṃ praśāstari sati, yasmāt niyamena teṣāṃ pravartana, tasmād asti bhayakāraṇaṃ teṣāṃ praśāstṛ brahma /
analyzed: bhīṣā bhayena asmāt vātaḥ pavate bhīṣā udeti sūryaḥ bhīṣā asmāt agniḥ ca indraḥ ca mṛtyuḥ dhāvati paścamaḥ iti vāta ādayaḥ hi mahārhāḥ svayam īśvarāḥ santaḥ pavana ādi kāryeṣu āyāsa bahuleṣu niyatāḥ pravartante tat yuktam praśāstari sati yasmāt niyamena teṣām tasmāt asti bhaya kāraṇam teṣām praśāstṛ brahma

original: yatas te bhṛtyā iva rājño 'smād brahmaṇo bhayena pravartante tac ca bhayakāraṇam ānandaṃ brahma / tasyāsya brahmaṇa ānandasyaiṣā mīmāṃsā vicāraṇā bhavati / kim ānandasya mīmāṃsyam ity ucyate / kim ānando viṣayaviṣayisambandhajanito laukikānandavadāhosvitsvābhāvika, ity evam eṣā ānandasya mīmāṃsā /
analyzed: yatas te bhṛtyāḥ iva rājñaḥ smāt brahmaṇaḥ bhayena pravartante tat ca bhaya kāraṇam ānandam brahma tasya asya brahmaṇaḥ ānandasya eṣā mīmāṃsā vicāraṇā bhavati kim ānandasya mīmāṃsyam iti ucyate kim ānandaḥ viṣaya viṣayi sambandha janitaḥ laukika ānanda vat āhosvit svābhāvikaḥ iti evam eṣā ānandasya mīmāṃsā

original: tatra laukika ānando bāhyādhyātmikasādhasampattinimitta utkṛṣṭaḥ / sa ya eṣa nirdiśyate brahmānandānugamārtham / anena hi prasiddhenānandena vyāvṛttaviṣayabudbhigamya ānando 'nugantuṃ śakyate /
analyzed: tatra laukikaḥ ānandaḥ bāhya ādhyātmika sādha sampatti nimittaḥ utkṛṣṭaḥ sa yaḥ eṣa nirdiśyate brahma ānanda anugama artham anena hi prasiddhena ānandena vyāvṛtta viṣaya budbhi gamyaḥ ānandaḥ nugantum śakyate

original: laukiko 'py ānando brahmānandasyaiva mātrā avidyayā tiraskriyamāṇe vijñāna utkṛṣyamāṇāyāṃ cāvidyāyāṃ brahmādibhiḥ karmavaśādyathāvijñānaṃ viṣayādisādhanasambandhavaśāc ca vibhāvyamānaś ca loke 'navasthito laukikaḥ sampadyate /
analyzed: laukikaḥ pi ānandaḥ brahma ānandasya eva mātrā avidyayā tiraskriyamāṇe vijñāne utkṛṣyamāṇāyām ca avidyāyām brahma ādibhiḥ karma vaśāt yathāvijñānam viṣaya ādi sādhana sambandha vaśāt ca vibhāvyamānaḥ ca loke nava sthitaḥ laukikaḥ sampadyate

original: sa evāvidyākāmakarmāpakarṣeṇa manuṣyagandharvāyuttarottarabhūmiṣvakāmahatavidvacchrotriyapratyakṣo vibhāvyate śataguṇottarotarotkarṣeṇa yāvad dhiraṇyagarbhasya brahmaṇa ānanda iti / niraste tv avidyākṛte viṣayaviṣayivibhāge vidyayā svābhāvikaḥ paripūrṇa eka ānando 'dvaito bhavatīy etam arthaṃ vibhāvayiṣyann āha yuvā prathamavayāḥ /
analyzed: saḥ eva avidyā kāma karma apakarṣeṇa manuṣya gandharva āyu ttarottara bhūmiṣu a kāma hata vidvas śrotriya pratyakṣaḥ vibhāvyate śataguṇa uttarotara utkarṣeṇa yāvat hiraṇyagarbhasya brahmaṇaḥ ānandaḥ iti niraste tu avidyā kṛte viṣaya viṣayi vibhāge vidyayā svābhāvikaḥ paripūrṇaḥ ekaḥ ānandaḥ dvaitaḥ bhavati id etam artham vibhāvayiṣyan āha yuvā prathama vayāḥ

original: sādhuyuveti sādhuś cāsau yuvā ceti yūno viśeṣaṇam / yuvāpy asādhur bhavati sādhur apy ayuvā ato viśeṣaṇaṃ yuvā syāt sādhuyuveti / adhyāyako 'dhītavedaḥ / āśiṣṭha aśāstṛtamaḥ / dṛḍhiṣṭho dṛḍhatamaḥ / baliṣṭho balavattamaḥ / evam ādhyātmikasādhanasampannaḥ /
analyzed: sādhu yuvā iti sādhuḥ ca asau yuvā ca iti yūnaḥ viśeṣaṇam yuvā api asādhuḥ bhavati sādhuḥ api ayuvā atas viśeṣaṇam yuvā syāt sādhu yuvā iti adhyāyakaḥ dhīta vedaḥ āśiṣṭha aśāstṛtamaḥ dṛḍhiṣṭhaḥ dṛḍhatamaḥ baliṣṭhaḥ balavattamaḥ evam ādhyātmika sādhana sampannaḥ

original: tasyeyaṃ pṛthivyurvīṃ sarvā vittasya vittenopabhogasādhanena dṛṣṭārthenādṛṣṭārthena ca karmasādhanena sampannā pūrṇā rājā pṛthivīpatir ity arthaḥ / tasya ca ya ānandaḥ sa eko mānuṣo manuṣyāṇāṃ prakṛṣṭa eka ānandaḥ / te ye śataṃ mānuṣā ānandāḥ sa eko manuṣyagandharvāṇām ānandaḥ / mānuṣānandācchataguṇenotkṛṣṭo manuṣyagandharvāṇām ānando bhavati /
analyzed: tasya iyam pṛthivī urvīm sarvā vittasya vittena upabhoga sādhanena dṛṣṭārthena a dṛṣṭa arthena ca karma sādhanena sampannā pūrṇā rājā pṛthivīpatiḥ iti arthaḥ tasya ca yaḥ ānandaḥ saḥ ekaḥ mānuṣaḥ manuṣyāṇām prakṛṣṭaḥ ekaḥ ānandaḥ te ye śatam mānuṣāḥ ānandāḥ saḥ ekaḥ manuṣya gandharvāṇām ānandaḥ mānuṣa ānandāt śataguṇena utkṛṣṭaḥ manuṣya gandharvāṇām ānandaḥ bhavati

original: manuṣyāḥ santaḥ karmavidyāviśeṣād gandharvatvaṃ prāptā manuṣyagandharvāḥ / te hy antardhānādiśaktisampannāḥ sūkṣmakāryakaraṇāḥ / tasmāt pratighātālpatvaṃ teṣāṃ dvandvapratighātaśaktiḥ sādhanasampattiś ca / tato 'pratihanyamānasya pratikāravato manuṣyagandharvasya syāc cittaprasādaḥ / tatprasādaviśeṣāt sukhaviśeṣābhivyaktiḥ /
analyzed: manuṣyāḥ santaḥ karma vidyā viśeṣāt gandharva tvam prāptāḥ manuṣya gandharvāḥ te hi antardhāna ādi śakti sampannāḥ sūkṣma kārya karaṇāḥ tasmāt pratighāta alpa tvam teṣām dvandva pratighāta śaktiḥ sādhana sampattiḥ ca pratihanyamānasya pratikāravataḥ manuṣya gandharvasya syāt citta prasādaḥ tad prasāda viśeṣāt sukha viśeṣa abhivyaktiḥ

original: evaṃ pūrvasyāḥ pūrvasyā bhūmer uttarasyām uttarasyāṃ bhūmau prasādaviśeṣataḥ śataguṇenānandotkarṣa upapadyate / prathamaṃ tv akāmahatāgrahaṇaṃ manuṣyaviṣayabhogakāmānabhihatasya śrotriyasya manuṣyānandāc chataguṇenānandotkarṣo manuṣyagandharveṇa tulyo vaktavya ity evam artham / sādhuyuvādhyāyaka iti śrotriyatvāvṛjinave gṛhyete /
analyzed: evam pūrvasyāḥ pūrvasyāḥ bhūmeḥ uttarasyām uttarasyām bhūmau prasāda viśeṣataḥ śataguṇena ānanda utkarṣaḥ upapadyate prathamam tu a kāma hata a grahaṇam manuṣya viṣaya bhoga kāma anabhihatasya śrotriyasya manuṣya ānandāt śataguṇena ānanda utkarṣaḥ manuṣya gandharveṇa tulyaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti evam artham sādhu yuvā adhyāyakaḥ iti śrotriya tva a vṛjinave gṛhyete

original: te hy aviśiṣṭe sarvatra / akāmahatatvaṃ tu viṣayotkarṣāpakarṣataḥ sukhotkarṣāpakarṣāya viśeṣyate / ato 'kāmahatagrahaṇam, tadviśeṣataḥ śataguṇasukhotkarṣopalabdher akāmahatatvasya paramānandaprāptisādhanavividhānārtham / vyākhyātamanyat / devagandhavā jātita eva / ciralokalokānām iti pitṝṇāṃ viśeṣaṇam /
analyzed: te hi a viśiṣṭe sarvatra a kāma hata tvam tu viṣaya utkarṣa apakarṣataḥ sukha utkarṣa apakarṣāya viśeṣyate kāma hata grahaṇam tad viśeṣataḥ śataguṇa sukha utkarṣa upalabdheḥ a kāma hata tvasya paramānanda prāpti sādhana vividhāna artham vyākhyātam anyat devagandhavāḥ jātitaḥ eva ciralokalokānām iti pitṝṇām viśeṣaṇam

original: cirakālasthāyī loko yeṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ te ciralokalokā iti / ājāna iti devalokas tasminn ājāne jātā ājānajā devāḥ, smārtakarmaviśeṣato devasthāneṣu jātāḥ / karma devā ye vaidikena karmaṇāgnihotrādinā kevalena devānapiyanti / devā iti trayaṃs triśaddhavirbhujaḥ / indras teṣāṃ svāmī / tasyācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ /
analyzed: cira kāla sthāyī lokaḥ yeṣām pitṝṇām te cira loka lokāḥ iti ājāne iti deva lokaḥ tasmin ājāne jātāḥ ājāna jāḥ devāḥ smārta karma viśeṣataḥ deva sthāneṣu jātāḥ karma devāḥ ye vaidikena karmaṇā agnihotra ādinā kevalena devān apiyanti devāḥ iti trayan triśat havirbhujaḥ indraḥ teṣām svāmī tasya ācāryaḥ bṛhaspatiḥ

original: prajāpatir virāṭ trailokyaśarīro brahmā samaṣṭivyaṣṭirūpaḥ saṃsāramaṇḍalavyāpī / yatraita anandabhedā ekatāṃ gacchanti dharmaś ca tannimitto jñānaṃ ca tadviṣayam akāmahatatvaṃ ca niratiśayaṃ yatra, sa eṣa hiraṇyagarbho brahmā tasyaiṣa ānandaḥ śrotriyeṇāvṛjinenākāmahatena ca sarvataḥ pratyakṣam upalabhyate /
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ virāj trailokya śarīraḥ brahmā samaṣṭi vyaṣṭi rūpaḥ saṃsāra maṇḍala vyāpī yatra eta ananda bhedāḥ ekatām gacchanti dharmaḥ ca tad nimittaḥ jñānam ca tad viṣayam a kāma hata tvam ca niratiśayam yatra saḥ eṣa hiraṇyagarbhaḥ brahmā tasya eṣaḥ ānandaḥ śrotriyeṇa a vṛjinena a kāma hatena ca sarvatas pratyakṣam upalabhyate

original: tasmād etāni trīṇi sādhanānīty avagamyate / tatra śrotriyatvāvṛjinatve niyate, akāmahatatvaṃ tūtkṛṣyata iti prakṛṣṭasādhanatā avagamyate / tasyākāmahatatvaprakarṣataś copalabhyamānaḥ śrotriyapratyakṣo brahmaṇa ānando yasya paramānandasya mātraikadeśaḥ / etasyaivānandasyānyāni bhūtāni mātrām upajīvanti (BĀU 4,3.32) iti śrutyantarāt /
analyzed: tasmāt etāni trīṇi sādhanāni iti avagamyate tatra śrotriya tva a vṛjina tve niyate akāma hata tvam tu utkṛṣyate iti prakṛṣṭa sādhana tā avagamyate tasya a  kāma hata tva prakarṣataḥ ca upalabhyamānaḥ śrotriya pratyakṣaḥ brahmaṇaḥ ānandaḥ yasya paramānandasya mātrā eka deśaḥ etasya eva  ānandasya anyāni bhūtāni mātrām upajīvanti PPr3In iti śruti antarāt
